universities.name: University of Oxford
universities.baseline_requirement: IB 38-40 total incl. core points, with 6s and 7s at HL (course-specific).
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard level: IELTS 7.5 (min 7.0 per component). IB route: English B HL 7 (or exemption if IB taught in English).
universities.admission_default: UCAS application by 15 Oct 2026 for 2027 entry; college application; admissions test (TMUA/ESAT/TARA/UCAT/LNAT) where required; December interviews; written work for many humanities.

universities.name: University of Cambridge
universities.baseline_requirement: IB 41-42 typical offer with 776 at Higher Level; subject-specific HL requirements per course (e.g. Maths HL for STEM).
universities.english_requirement_default: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall (usually min 7.0 each element). C1-level English via school-leaving qual (e.g. IB English A HL) also accepted.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application by 15 Oct 2026 for 2027 entry; college application; admissions test (ESAT/TMUA/UCAT/LNAT/College) where required; December interviews; written work where required.

universities.name: Imperial College London
universities.baseline_requirement: IB 38-41 typical offer with HL 6s and 7s (course-specific). Maths HL required for most courses (AA preferred).
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard level: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 each); Higher level: IELTS 7.0 (min 6.5 each). IB route: English A (Lit or Lang&Lit) grade 4 SL/HL, or English B grade 6 SL / 5 HL.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application by 13 Jan 2027 (most courses) or 15 Oct 2026 (Medicine). ESAT for Engineering/Physical Sciences; TMUA for Computing/Maths; UCAT for Medicine.

universities.name: London School of Economics and Political Science
universities.baseline_requirement: IB 37-39 points overall with 666-766 at higher level; HL Mathematics (often grade 7, some courses require Analysis and Approaches) required for quantitative courses.
universities.english_requirement_default: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 7.0 in each component (one sitting). IB route: English A (Literature, Language & Literature, or Literature & Performance) any grade HL / at least 6 SL, or English B 7 HL.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application by 13 January 2027 (equal consideration). TMUA mandatory for BSc Economics and BSc Econometrics & Mathematical Economics, encouraged for other maths-intensive courses; LNAT mandatory for LLB.

universities.name: University College London (UCL)
universities.baseline_requirement: IB 36-40 points overall with 17-20 points in three HL subjects (no HL score below 5); HL 7 in Mathematics (AA or AI) required for quantitative courses; Mathematics BSc requires AA only.
universities.english_requirement_default: UCL English levels 1-5; most UG programmes require Level 2: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, min 6.5 each component. IB route: English A (Literature or Language & Literature) grade 5 at HL/SL for Levels 1-2 (grade 6 for Level 3); English B accepted only for Level 1.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application by 13 Jan 2027 (equal consideration) or 15 Oct 2026 (Medicine). TMUA required for Economics, TARA for Computer Science/Robotics, LNAT for Law, UCAT for Medicine; STEP for Mathematics BSc.

universities.name: University of Edinburgh

universities.name: The University of Manchester

universities.admission_default: UCAS application. UCAT + interview mandatory for Medicine (SJT Band 3-4 not considered) and Dentistry; Nursing shortlists applicants for interview. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 stated across Manchester 2027 course pages; international 2027/28 fees on published course pages range GBP 29,200 (classroom-based) to GBP 41,900 (Materials Science and Engineering); Medicine/Dentistry pages publish 2026/27 figures (Home GBP 9,535; international GBP 38,300-39,900 pre-clinical).

universities.name: University of Bristol
universities.baseline_requirement: IB typically 34-40 points overall with 17-18 at Higher Level per course (e.g. English/Geography/Cellular and Molecular Medicine 34 with 17 at HL; most sciences, Law-family and business courses 36 with 18 at HL; Computer Science/Physics/Psychology/Economics/Law 38 with 18 at HL; Mathematics, Economics and Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science 40). HL subject requirements per course; Mathematics courses accept HL Mathematics either Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations (HL 6-7 typical); Economics-family courses also accept 7 at SL Analysis and Approaches. Contextual offers published per course (typically 2-4 points lower).
universities.english_requirement_default: Course-assigned Bristol English profiles A-G with IB routes on each profile page. Profile E (most sciences, engineering, geography): IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills; IB English A: Literature 5 at SL or 4 at HL / A: Literature and Language 5 at SL or HL / B: English 6 at SL or 5 at HL. Profile B (Law, Psychology, History, Philosophy, Veterinary Science): IELTS 7.0 with 7.0 in writing and 6.5 in all other skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or 5 HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. Profile A (Medicine, Dentistry, English BA): IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in all skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 7 SL or 6 HL / B 7 at HL. Profile G (Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Mathematics, Accounting and Finance, International Business Management): IELTS 6.5 with 7.0 in reading and listening, no score below 6.0; IB A: Literature 5 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. Profile C (Politics and International Relations): IELTS 6.5 with 6.5 in all skills; IB A: Literature and A: Literature and Language 5 at SL or HL / B 6 at SL or HL.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application; equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for 2027 entry (Bristol apply/dates page — page prints "13 January 2026" [sic; UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration date is 13 January 2027]) and 15 October 2026 for Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Science. UCAT + interview (Nov-Apr) + DBS check for Medicine and Dentistry; LNAT for Law LLB; mandatory vacation Extra-Mural Studies (EMS) for Veterinary Science. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 (Bristol fees page: "2027/28: £10,050 (confirmed)"); international 2027-entry fees on course pages range GBP 26,500 (Law, Philosophy, Politics and International Relations) to GBP 51,600 (Dentistry); most classroom courses GBP 29,300, most lab courses GBP 32,500-34,700, Medicine GBP 47,600, Veterinary Science GBP 43,500.

universities.name: University of Warwick
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: IB typically 32-39 points overall per course. English Literature/History/Philosophy 36; Film and Television Studies/Modern Languages 32; Biomedical Science/Biochemistry/Chemistry 34; Accounting and Finance/Economics/Economics and Management/EPAIS/PPE/Law LLB/Management/International Management 38; Engineering MEng (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/Automotive/Systems) 38 including 6,6,6 HL in Mathematics and Physics; Physics BSc/Mathematics and Physics 38 including 7 in HL Mathematics (AA only); Data Science/MORSE/Mathematics and Statistics 38-39 by route with HL Maths (AA or AI) 6-7 and TMUA 5.0/STEP 2/AEA Distinction as one option; Computer Science/Discrete Mathematics 39 with 7,6,6 including 7 in HL Mathematics (AA only); Mathematics BSc/MMath 39 with 6 HL Mathematics (AA only) plus TMUA or STEP. Contextual offers 2-4 points lower at every course.
universities.english_requirement_default: Three-band English system (Warwick English Language Requirements, page updated 28 October 2026). Band A (most STEM: Computer Science, Discrete Mathematics, Data Science, Mathematics, MMath, Mathematics and Physics, Mathematics and Statistics, Engineering, Biomedical Science, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, Biological Sciences): IELTS 6.0 min 5.5 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 4 or SL 4; IB English B HL 4 or SL 5. Band B (Psychology, Cyber Security, MORSE, English Literature, History, Philosophy, Film and Television Studies, Modern Languages): IELTS 6.5 min 6.0 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 4 or SL 4; IB English B HL 4 or SL 5. Band C (Economics, Economics and Management, EPAIS, PPE, Law LLB, Accounting and Finance, Management, International Management): IELTS 7.0 min 6.5 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 5 or SL 5; IB English B HL 5 or SL 6. Economics-family course pages add explicit GCSE/IB English caveat: "You will also need grade 6/B in GCSE English Language or International Baccalaureate grade 5 in English A (Higher or Standard Level), grade 5 in Higher Level English B or grade 6 in Standard Level English B."
universities.admission_default: UCAS application; UCAS 2027 equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 at 18:00 (Warwick Key dates page). Warwick does not typically interview applicants. Admissions tests (Warwick TMUA page): TMUA required for Computer Science (G400 BSc / G403 MEng / GN42 BSc CS-Business / G190 BSc Discrete / G4G3 MEng Discrete, not for Computer Systems Engineering); TMUA or STEP required for Mathematics (G100 BSc / G103 MMath); TMUA 5.0 or STEP grade 2 included as one optional route in most offers for Statistics family (GG13 BSc MathStat / GGC3 MMathStat / GLN0 BSc MORSE / G0L0 MMORSE / 7G73 BSc Data Science / G304 MSci Data Science); TMUA optional-but-encouraged for Economics family (L100 BSc Economics / LLD2 EPAIS / LN12 Economics and Management). Law LLB: "Our Law programmes do not currently require the LNAT for admissions consideration." Home fee (tuition_eu) 2027-28 = GBP 10,050 (Warwick Fees page). Overseas 2026-27 fees: Band 1 £27,870 (classroom-based, Humanities, most Social Science) / Band 2 £35,530 (laboratory, Mathematics, Statistics, Theatre and Performance Studies, Economics, WBS); 2027-28 Overseas fees not yet published.

universities.name: Durham University
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month

universities.english_requirement_default: IB route (Durham Other English Language Qualifications page): 'International Baccalaureate Standard or Higher level English 5 or better'. Otherwise IELTS Academic band 6.5-7.0 overall (no element below band 6.0), as stated on Durham course pages.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application; UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Durham How to Apply page: "you'll need to apply by the January UCAS Equal Consideration Date"). LNAT required for Law LLB; TMUA strongly encouraged (optional) for Mathematics G100/G103, where a suitable TMUA or STEP performance may reduce the offer. This tuition fee will increase to £10,050 in 2027/28."). International 2027/28 fees shown on course pages: humanities and social sciences GBP 29,500-30,000, Law GBP 31,000, Business School and Mathematics GBP 32,500, Geography GBP 33,000, Computer Science GBP 35,000, laboratory sciences and Engineering GBP 36,000.

universities.name: University of Bath
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: IB offers for 2027 entry: 35 points overall with 6,6,5 or 6,5,5 at Higher Level for Pharmacy MPharm (B230), Sociology and Social Policy, Criminology and Modern Languages BA; 36 points overall for all other published undergraduate offers, with HL patterns from 6,6,5 (Chemistry, Biology, Management-family) through 7,6,6 to 7,7,6 in three Higher Level subjects including essential subjects (Computer Science 7,7,6 incl. 6 in either HL Mathematics; Mechanical/Aerospace/Integrated Design Engineering MEng 7,7,6 incl. 6 in Physics and 7 in either HL Mathematics). Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches at Higher Level is compulsory for Mathematics, Mathematics and Statistics and Economics and Mathematics (Applications & Interpretations not accepted); most other quantitative courses accept either HL Mathematics course, and several publish Standard Level AA (grade 6-7) alternative routes. GCSE Mathematics requirements (grade 4/C to 7/A by course) are met by any IB Higher or Standard Level Mathematics: 'We accept any IB Higher or Standard Level in English or Mathematics as meeting our essential GCSE requirements' (Bath qualification guidance page). Contextual offers published per course (typically 6,6,6 or 7,6,5 HL).
universities.english_requirement_default: Three-category system (Bath English language requirements for qualifications pages). All three categories accept the IB route: 'International Baccalaureate - Standard or Higher Level in English (any) Grade 3'. Otherwise IELTS Academic: Category C (Computer Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Sport and Exercise Science, Sport Management and Coaching, Modern Languages, Economics and Mathematics): IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in all components. Category A (Management, Management with Marketing, Business, Accounting and Finance, International Management and Modern Languages, Psychology, Architecture) and Category B (Economics, Pharmacy MPharm, Criminology, Sociology and Social Policy, International Development with Economics): IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in all components. Bath's published Category A and Category B pages currently print identical IELTS/IB requirements.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application. UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027, printed as both Home and Overseas application deadlines on all 2027 course pages. No Medicine, Dentistry or Veterinary degrees at Bath; the professional undergraduate entry is Pharmacy MPharm, which requires a selection interview (overseas applicants interviewed remotely), an Enhanced DBS check in the first semester and a Fitness to Practise self-declaration (GPhC). Architecture: 'We will usually assess you based on your UCAS application and we do not consider portfolios.' Mathematical Sciences degrees: 'we do not consider additional Maths tests such as STEP, MAT or TMUA as part of our admissions process.' Home fee (tuition_eu) is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 (Bath 'Tuition fees for undergraduate students starting in 2027' page; UK regulated fee, subject to parliamentary approval). Overseas 2027/28 band fees from the same page: Band 1 library-based Humanities & Social Sciences GBP 26,150 (exceptions: Economics-related courses and Sport and Exercise Science/Psychology priced elsewhere); Band 2 Economics (and related) and School of Management courses GBP 29,500 (incl. BSc International Management and Modern Languages, BSc Economics, BSc Economics and Mathematics); Band 3 all Science, Engineering, Health and Psychology courses GBP 32,950. 2027 course pages print 'Fee information is not yet available for this course', so figures are taken from the central schedule; reduced placement-year fees apply (Humanities & Social Sciences GBP 7,265; School of Management GBP 14,750; Engineering/Science/Health/Psychology GBP 9,155). Overseas fees may rise by up to 8% per year.

universities.name: University of St Andrews
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: Scottish four-year degrees. IB Diploma 2027-entry offers are published per course as Standard and Minimum entry grades: Standard 38 (HL 6,6,6) for Computer Science (incl. HL6 Mathematics + SL5 in a listed science), Mathematics BSc/MMath, Statistics, Physics BSc/MPhys, Astrophysics MPhys (physics degrees incl. HL6 Mathematics and Physics), Chemistry BSc/MChem (incl. HL6 Chemistry + HL6 in one listed science), Geography, Sustainable Development, Economics, Financial Economics, Management, International Relations, History (incl. HL6 History) and English (incl. HL6 English); Standard 36 (HL 6,6,5) for Biology, Marine Biology, Biochemistry (HL6 Biology + HL6 Chemistry), Neuroscience (HL5 in two of Biology/Chemistry/Mathematics/Physics), Psychology, Classics, Art History, Social Anthropology, Film Studies, French (incl. French B HL6 or French A SL7) and Theological Studies. Minimum entry grades are 36 (HL 6,5,5) across courses; Gateway programmes support contextual applicants who narrowly miss Minimum grades. General entry requirements (or IB equivalent) for every course: SQA National 5 (B)/GCSE (5) in English plus one listed science/mathematics subject. tuition_eu is the 2027-entry RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Republic of Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man) rate GBP 10,050 per year printed on 2027 course pages ("yet to be confirmed by the UK Government"); Home (Scotland) fee TBC by the Scottish Government (2025-2026 was GBP 1,820, SAAS-paid for eligible Scottish students). International (EU and overseas) 2027-entry fee GBP 34,910 per year for Faculty of Arts, Divinity and Science degrees; Medicine 2026-2027 entrant fee GBP 39,620. No admissions tests for the undergraduate courses researched; interviews only for Medicine, Gateway/supported pathway programmes and part-time study. Direct entry to second year possible for well-qualified applicants in many science degrees.
universities.english_requirement_default: Faculty English-language profiles (test-taker route): Faculty of Science Profile 7-D IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component; Faculty of Arts and Divinity (all Schools except the School of English) Profile 3-D IELTS 7.0 with 6.5 in each; School of English Profile 1-D IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in each; Medicine Profile 2-M. No test score needed if the applicant holds an English-medium secondary/high-school leaving qualification taken at a school with a substantial English-language educational environment (registered for at least the final two years; schools in UKVI majority English-speaking countries, Singapore and IB English-medium schools meet this), including at least one subject with a substantial component of writing in English. Test scores accepted only within two years of the programme start date.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application (UCAS name STA, number code S36); overseas students may instead use the Common Application or a Direct Application. Equal consideration deadline for all MA and BSc undergraduate applications: 6pm (GMT) Wednesday 13 January 2027; Medicine: 6pm (GMT) Thursday 15 October 2026. Personal statement and academic reference required; most applicants are not interviewed (exceptions: Medicine, supported pathway programmes, part-time study). Applicants from other countries should use the Standard entry requirements; Standard, Minimum and Gateway levels are explained on the academic entry explained page.

universities.name: University of Glasgow
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: Scottish four-year degrees (many MA (Hons) and MA (SocSci) programmes, BSc in sciences and engineering; some degrees route into MSci or MEng for strong students). IB Diploma 2027-entry offers are published per course as "IB standard entry requirements" of the form "NN (HL a,b,c)": 38 (6,6,6) for Computing Science, Software Engineering MEng, Mechanical/Aeronautical/Civil/Electronic & Electrical/Biomedical Engineering MEng, Medicine MBChB, Veterinary Medicine & Surgery BVMS and Psychology BSc (upper bound); 36 (6,6,6) for Dentistry BDS; 36 (6,6,5) for Business & Management MA (SocSci), Economics MA (SocSci), Politics MA (Hons) and Sociology MA (SocSci); 34 (6,5,5) for Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Physics with Astrophysics MPhys, Genetics, Zoology, Neuroscience and English Literature MA (Hons); 32 (5,5,5) for Chemistry and Geography BSc; 32 (6,5,5) lower bound for History/Philosophy/Classics/French/Film & Television Studies/Archaeology MA (Hons) and International Relations MA (SocSci). Several programmes quote a range (e.g. Psychology "38 (6,6,6 HL) - 34 (6,5,5 HL)"; Scots Law LLB and International Relations "38 - 32/34"). HL subject requirements per course: Mathematics (Analysis & Approaches) HL 6 required for Computing Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Chemistry and all Engineering routes; HL Biology or Chemistry for Life Sciences; HL Chemistry and HL Biology plus UCAT for Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Medicine; HL English (or Humanities) plus LNAT for Scots Law LLB. Where a programme spans both BEng and MEng, the printed IB offer is "BEng 34 (6,5,5); MEng 38 (6,6,6)". tuition_eu is the published RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland) 2026/27 standard fee GBP 9,790; the 2027/28 RUK standard fee is not yet published on Glasgow live fees pages. Scotland fee is GBP 1,820 (SAAS-paid for eligible Scottish students). International 2027/28 fees printed on Glasgow international fees page: Arts and Social Sciences programmes GBP 28,275; Science, Engineering, Nursing and College of Medical, Veterinary and Life Sciences programmes GBP 33,708; Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) GBP 60,255; Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine and Surgery (BVMS) GBP 38,670; MBChB and CMVLS clinical programmes GBP 67,112. Note: live Glasgow course pages currently serve the IB offer only through a JavaScript country selector; the IB figures above are endorsed from Wayback captures of Glasgow 2026/27 course pages (2025-09/2025-10 snapshots), as flagged in each row's deadline_notes.
universities.english_requirement_default: Glasgow standard English route: International Baccalaureate English A SL5 or HL5, or English B SL6 or HL5. IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no subtests below 6.0 is the standard for non-English-speaking applicants; some programmes (Medicine, Dentistry, Law) require IELTS 7.0 with 7.0 in each component - see course page for current exact requirement.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application. UCAS equal consideration deadlines printed on Glasgow how-to-apply date page: 18:00 (UK) Wednesday 13 January 2027 for most programmes; 18:00 (UK) Thursday 15 October 2026 for Medicine (A100), Dentistry (A200/A203) and Veterinary Medicine (D100). UCAT mandatory for Medicine MBChB and Dentistry BDS; interview follows for shortlisted applicants (Multiple Mini-Interview for Veterinary Medicine). LNAT (National Admissions Test for Law) mandatory for Scots Law LLB. No other admissions tests for the undergraduate programmes researched; the standard offer is released after UCAS review without a mandatory interview for most Arts, Social Sciences and STEM programmes. Glasgow International College provides a foundation route into year 2 for applicants who narrowly miss entry requirements.

universities.name: University of Exeter
universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: IB offers for 2027 entry are published per course as total points with Higher Level grade slips: 38/766 for BMBS Medicine (HL 6 in Chemistry and HL 6 in Biology, plus UCAT or GAMSAT); 38/766-36/666 for BSc Economics and BSc Economics and Finance (HL5 or SL6 in Mathematics AA or AI; Maths Studies not accepted); 36/666 for LLB Law and BSc Psychology (HL6 in a Science subject); 36/666-34/665 for BSc Computer Science (HL5 Mathematics AA or AI), BSc Mathematics and BSc Mathematics with Economics (HL6 Mathematics AA only), BSc Geography (HL5 in a science subject), BSc Physics (36/666-32/655; HL6 Mathematics AA and HL5 Physics, or HL5 Mathematics AA and HL6 Physics); 34/665-32/655 for MEng Mechanical Engineering and MEng Renewable Energy Engineering (HL5 Mathematics AA or AI plus HL5 in another science subject); 34/665 for BA Politics, BA International Relations, BA History, BA English (HL5 in an accepted Humanities or Social Science subject) and Business School BScs (Business and Management, Marketing and Management, Accounting and Finance; GCSE B/5 Mathematics or A-Level Maths route); 34/665-32/655 for BSc Environmental Science and BSc Exercise and Sport Sciences (HL5 in a science subject); 32/655 for BSc Biological Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 another Science), BSc Biomedical Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 another accepted Science), BSc Neuroscience (HL5 in two Science subjects), BSc Zoology, BSc Marine Biology (HL5 in a science subject), BSc/BA Classics and BA Film & Television Studies; 32/655-30/555 for BA/BSc Sociology, BSc Criminology, BA Archaeology and BA Modern Languages (language requirement depends on language level chosen). GCSE grade C/4 in English Language required across courses; some science and business courses also require GCSE B/5 or 6 in Mathematics (Maths Transition Course route may apply if one grade below). Contextual offers typically 2-4 points lower, quoted on course pages as an example based on 2022 entry. tuition_eu is Exeter's published 2027/28 Home standard fee £10,050 ("it is the University of Exeter's intention to charge the revised standard tuition fee of £10,050 per year... for each year of your studies"; BMBS Medicine years one to four at the standard fee, year five paid by the NHS assuming current funding arrangements). tuition_noneu is the published 2027/28 international fee printed on course pages: £25,700 Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (including Law) and Accounting, Finance, Business & Management, Economics and Marketing; £31,500 Computer Science, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Ecology and Conservation, Engineering, Geology, Geography, Mathematics and Statistics, Medical Imaging, Natural Sciences, Neuroscience, Nursing, Physics, Sport and Health Sciences; £32,150 Biosciences, Biomedical Sciences, Psychology; £49,300 BMBS Medicine (Exeter 2027 fees page; fees "expected to increase modestly in line with Consumer Price Index... in each year of study").
universities.english_requirement_default: Exeter English language Profiles A-G vary by course (named on each course page). Profiles B1 and B2 cover most undergraduate courses: B1 = IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in any section; B2 = IELTS 6.5 overall and no less than 6.0 in any section (e.g. Biosciences, Psychology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Exercise and Sport Sciences). IB route for Profiles A, B1 and B2: International Baccalaureate English as a First Language Language A: Literature or Language A: Language and Literature Grade 4 at SL or HL; Language B: English Grade 6 at SL or Grade 5 at HL. BMBS Medicine requires Profile G: IELTS 7.5 with no less than 7.0 in any section; IB English A SL5 or HL4, English B SL7 or HL6. Alternatives include TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, pre-sessional English at the University of Exeter International Study Centre; tests valid 2 years before programme start (school qualifications such as IB accepted for 7 years).
universities.admission_default: UCAS application for all full-time courses (University of Exeter UCAS code E84 EXETR). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Exeter Applying via UCAS page: applications should reach UCAS between 1 September and the UCAS equal consideration deadline; applications received after this date considered if places are still available). Medicine BMBS applicants must apply between 1 September and 15 October 2026; UCAT or GAMSAT mandatory for all BMBS applicants (interview follows for shortlisted applicants). No other admissions tests for the undergraduate courses researched; offers are released after UCAS review without a mandatory interview for most programmes. Contextual offers published per course (example based on offers made to students starting in 2022). Exeter International Foundation course provides a route into Year 1 for applicants who narrowly miss entry requirements.

universities.name: University of Leeds
universities.baseline_requirement: IB offers for 2027 entry are published per course either as a Higher Level slip ('18 points at Higher level', '17 points at Higher Level', '6,6,5 at HL') or as a total plus HL slip. Engineering (Mechanical, Electronic & Electrical, Civil, Aeronautical/Aerospace MEng,BEng) and Computer Science BSc publish 18 points at HL with 6 in HL Mathematics AA or 5 in HL Mathematics AI (Civil inverts the grades); Chemical Engineering MEng,BEng slips at 15 HL points. Mathematics BSc and Actuarial Mathematics BSc publish 17 points at HL including 6 in HL Mathematics (AA preferred). Physics MPhys,BSc publishes 18 HL points (HL 5 Physics + HL 5 Maths). Chemistry MChem,BSc slips at 6,6,5 HL including Chemistry. Biology/Biomedical Sciences/Neuroscience publish a total of 31 overall with 6,6,5 HL including Biology and another science. Psychology BSc publishes 35 overall with a HL science at grade 6 plus GCSE Maths grade 5 (B) or IB SL equivalent. Leeds University Business School - Economics BSc, Economics and Finance BSc, Business Management BA, International Business BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc - all publish 35 overall with 17 HL points plus Maths via SL 5 or HL 4 and English via SL/HL or through another qualification. Law LLB: 35 overall (6,6,5 HL). Medicine and Surgery MBChB: 36 overall with 6 in each of 3 HL subjects including Chemistry and Biology; SL 5 in English and Maths if not at GCSE. Geography BA slips 18 HL; Geography BSc slips 6,6,5 HL including an accepted subject. Politics BA, International Relations BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA and Communication and Media BA publish 35 overall / 16 HL (English Literature, Philosophy, Media and Communication add an English grade condition). Global Development BA and Sociology BA publish 34 overall (6,5,5 HL). Fine Art BA publishes 34 overall with 16 HL and 4 in English. Food Science BSc and Nutrition BSc publish 6,5,5 HL including two science subjects. GCSE English Language grade 4 (C) is required across courses (GCSE Maths grade 4 for Food Science, Nutrition and some Business programmes). Contextual Access to Leeds offers typically 1-2 grades lower at A-level.
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard undergraduate band is IELTS 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each section (Leeds English language requirements page). IB route: English A (first language) Literature or Language and Literature grade 4 at HL or SL; English B (second language) grade 5 at HL or 6 at SL; English Literature and Performance and English Ab Initio not accepted; English B SL not accepted for courses with IELTS 7.0+ requirement. universities.admission_default: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses. universities.name: University of Birmingham
universities.baseline_requirement: Birmingham publishes the IB offer per course as a three-subject Higher Level slip plus a minimum overall diploma score of 32 points (Birmingham Undergraduate entry requirements page: "Our policy on the IB qualification is focused on attainment in the Higher Level subjects. Therefore, offers are based on three Higher Level grades with a minimum overall mark of 32." - "Note that this excludes Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences"). Published mappings: A*AA = 7,6,6 at Higher Level (with required subjects) and a minimum of 32 points overall; AAA = 6,6,6 at HL with 32 overall; AAB = 6,6,5 at HL with 32 overall; ABB = 6,5,5 at HL with 32 overall. Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science BSc and Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Computer Science BSc IB 7,6,6 at HL to include 6 in Mathematics plus 5 in Standard Level English, min 32 overall; Mathematics BSc IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics; Physics BSc IB 7,6,6 at HL including Mathematics and Physics; Chemistry BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,6,5 at HL including Chemistry; Biological Sciences BSc IB 6,6,5 including Biology/Human Biology plus one from Chemistry, Physics, Maths AA, Maths AI, Statistics, Geology, Geography or Psychology; Human Neuroscience BSc IB 6,6,6 at HL (no subject-specific condition); Psychology BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 at HL; Economics BSc IB 6,6,6 including Mathematics; Money, Banking and Finance BSc IB 6,6,5 at HL including Mathematics; Business Management BSc and Marketing BSc IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Accounting and Finance BSc IB 6,6,6 with 32 overall plus GCSE Mathematics grade 6; Law LLB IB 6,6,6 including 32 points overall (LNAT is NOT required - course page explicitly states Birmingham does not require or consider the LNAT); Medicine and Surgery MBChB IB 6,6,6 at HL including Chemistry and a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths plus UCAT and interview; Dental Surgery BDS IB 6,6,6 at HL including Chemistry and Biology with 32 overall plus UCAT and interview; Pharmacy MPharm IB 6,6,5 at HL including Chemistry plus Biology, Physics or Maths; Nursing (Adult) BNurs IB 5,5,5 at HL with three subjects; Mechanical / Civil / Electronic and Electrical / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics with 32 overall (Chemical Engineering MEng IB 7,6,6 at HL including Mathematics plus Chemistry or Physics HL grade 6; Materials Science and Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics plus one of Computer Science, Biology, Physics, Chemistry or Design Technology); Politics BA and International Relations BA IB 6,6,5 at HL with 32 overall; Sociology BA, Ancient History and Archaeology BA IB 6,5,5 at HL with 32 overall; English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Liberal Arts BA IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Theology and Religion BA IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall; Modern Languages BA IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall plus Higher Level grade 5 for any advanced language; Music BMus IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall including HL 5 in Music (audition/interview may be required for applicants without the A-level Music equivalent or ABRSM Grade 8 Performance/Grade 6 Theory); Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 at HL dependent on the number of preferred science subjects; Geography BSc IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Environmental Science BSc IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall including a Required Science. General literacy/numeracy rule: GCSE English and GCSE Mathematics both grade 4 or above (some courses require higher); applicants must be 17 by 1 October of the year of entry (18 for programmes with mandatory clinical placements). Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year ("If your offer is for 2027 year of entry, we expect that the tuition fee for your first year of study will be GBP 10,050"; Parliament approval caveat).
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard undergraduate band is IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any band (engineering, sciences, geography, environmental science). Birmingham Business School and Law programmes (Economics BSc, Money Banking and Finance BSc, Business Management BSc, Marketing BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc) require IELTS 6.5 overall with minimum of 6.5 in Writing and Speaking and 6.0 in Listening and Reading. Law LLB, Politics BA, International Relations BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Modern Languages BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Human Neuroscience BSc and Psychology BSc require IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any band. Medicine MBChB, Dentistry BDS and Nursing (Adult) BNurs require IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 7.0 in any band; Pharmacy MPharm requires IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in any band. IB English route is built into the IB offer per course (e.g. Computer Science course page: "We also require 5 in Standard Level English"). Alternatives: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, Cambridge English C1 Advanced, LanguageCert ESOL SELT, Trinity ISE II/III; Presessional English course offered for applicants with a conditional offer.
universities.admission_default: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses (University of Birmingham UCAS campus code B32). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (Birmingham How to apply for undergraduate study page). UCAS 2027-entry deadline for Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200): Thursday 15 October 2026. Admissions tests: UCAT in year of application plus interview required for Medicine MBChB and Dentistry BDS; LNAT is NOT required for Law LLB (course page: "We do not require or consider the LNAT admissions test for entry onto our programmes"). No TMUA, MAT, STEP or other admissions test listed for other undergraduate courses; Engineering applicants without A-level Mathematics may be asked to sit a Birmingham Mathematics Aptitude test. Music BMus may require an audition/interview for applicants without the standard Music qualification; ABRSM Grade 8 Performance or Grade 6 Theory accepted as alternative. Additional reductions: contextual offers (typically one grade lower), Pathways to Birmingham (typically two grades lower), EPQ alternative offer (one grade lower plus grade B in EPQ; excludes Medicine A100 and Dentistry A200), Core Maths alternative offer for selected programmes (excludes programmes with A-level Mathematics requirement), Music performance Grade 8 alternative offer, county-level sport alternative offer. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year tuition printed per course: GBP 24,840 (Politics BA, International Relations BA); GBP 25,320 (Modern Languages BA); GBP 26,220 (Law LLB, Sociology BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Ancient History and Archaeology BA); GBP 27,300 (English Literature BA); GBP 28,680 (Economics, Money Banking and Finance, Business Management, Marketing); GBP 30,180 (Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Finance, Pharmacy MPharm, Nursing Adult BNurs); GBP 31,680 (Materials Science and Engineering MEng); GBP 33,300 (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, all engineering MEng courses except Materials); Medicine MBChB international GBP 33,750 per year for pre-clinical years 1-2 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 3-5; Dentistry BDS international GBP 30,180 for pre-clinical year 1 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 2-5. universities.baseline_requirement: Southampton does not publish a single blanket IB Diploma minimum; entry requirements are stated per course page as a total Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Archaeology BA 'Pass, with overall score of 30 points with 15 points at Higher Level'; Computer Science BSc 'Pass, with 34 points overall, with 17 points required at Higher Level including 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Biomedical Engineering MEng 'Pass, with 38 points overall with 19 points required at Higher Level, including 6 at Higher Level in Physics (or Biology/Chemistry/Computer Science) and 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Medicine BM5 BMBS 'Overall score of 36 points with 18 at Higher Level, with 6 in Biology and one additional Science'). Southampton accepts both Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL) for all IB-relevant undergraduate courses (per course page IB Diploma entries); Analysis and Approaches is preferred for many Engineering/CS/Maths/Physics courses; Acoustical Engineering MEng explicitly asks either 6 at HL in AA or 7 at HL in AI. Applicants without the required HL subjects can apply for the Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year. GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above is typically required, or an equivalent (course page 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University'). IB Career-Related Programme (IBCP) accepted — 'Offers will be made on the individual Diploma Course subject(s) and the career-related study qualification. The CP core will not form part of the offer.' Contextual offers available for eligible Home applicants ('Applicants who are highlighted in this way will be made an offer which is lower than the typical offer for that programme'). Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (course pages 'UK students pay GBP 10,050'; Southampton Tuition fees, funding and scholarships undergraduate page).
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard Southampton undergraduate band is IELTS Academic overall score 6.5 with minimum 6.0 in reading, 6.0 in writing, 6.0 in speaking and 6.0 in listening (course pages 'IELTS score requirements': overall 6.5 / reading 6.0 / writing 6.0 / speaking 6.0 / listening 6.0). Law LLB requires IELTS overall 6.5 with minimum 6.5 in each component (Law LLB course page IELTS score requirements). Medicine BM5 BMBS requires IELTS overall 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in each component (Medicine BM5 course page IELTS score requirements). Pre-sessional English programmes offered where the IELTS requirement is not met (course pages: 'If you do not meet the English language requirements through a test or qualification, you may be able to meet them by completing one of our pre-sessional English programmes before your course starts'). English language equivalency routes (TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge English, etc.) and IB-based English equivalencies live on Southampton's English language requirements pages (https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements).
universities.admission_default: All full-time undergraduate applications are made through UCAS; University of Southampton UCAS institution code S27 (code name SOTON; Southampton Apply through UCAS page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications for most undergraduate courses'). Medicine BM5 (A100) UCAS deadline Thursday 15 October 2026 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications to the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, and for most courses in medicine, dentistry, and veterinary medicine/science'; BM5 course page: 'All applicants must sit the UCAT test before the 15th October UCAS deadline'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Selection: UCAT required for Medicine BM5 with ranking to interview (BM5 course page 'Selection to Interview: All applicants who meet the entry requirements through either achieved or predicted grades at the point of application are ranked by UCAT score and the top number of applicants invited to interview'); portfolio is required for art courses only (Southampton Apply through UCAS page: 'you may also be asked to submit a portfolio. This is typically for Arts courses such as: BA Hons Graphic Arts, BA Fine Art, BA Games, Design and Art'); LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT required for Southampton Law LLB (Law LLB course page Non-academic entry requirements: 'LNAT is not required for our programmes'). Age requirement: applicants must be 18 or over at the start of Medicine BM5 (course page 'Applicants must be 18 or over at the start of the course'). Physics BSc/MPhys applicants may be invited for an optional departmental interview which may lower the offer (Physics course pages 'The optional interview may lead to a lower offer'). Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year rates printed per course: GBP 27,500 (English BA, Two Modern Languages BA); GBP 28,300 (Archaeology BA, History BA, Economics BSc, Economics and Actuarial Science BSc, Business Management BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc); GBP 28,400 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Film Studies BA); GBP 29,800 (Mathematics BSc, Mathematics with Actuarial Science BSc); GBP 31,000 (Biomedical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,000 (Computer Science BSc, Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence MEng, Software Engineering MEng); GBP 33,500 (Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Maritime/Acoustical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,900 (Biology BSc, Biomedical Sciences BSc, Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Oceanography BSc, Physical Geography BSc); GBP 34,100 (Physics BSc, Physics MPhys, Chemistry BSc, Chemistry MChem); Medicine BM5 BMBS international GBP 35,900 per year.

universities.living_cost_source: national estimate (UK student visa), £1,171 a month
universities.baseline_requirement: Sheffield publishes an IB Diploma offer per course, stated as an overall Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Computer Science BSc IB Diploma: '36, with 6 in HL Maths; 34, with 6 in HL Maths, and A in the Extended Essay; 34, with 6 in HL Maths and 5 in HL Computer Science'; A Level AAA including Maths / AAB including A in Maths and B in Computer Science). The standard typical-offer headline is usually one or two points above the alternative one which is conditional on grade A in the Extended Essay (or equivalent). Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science / Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths + A in EE, or + 5 in HL CS); Mathematics BSc and Financial Mathematics BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches) (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths AA + A in EE); Physics BSc IB 34 with 6,5 (in any order) in HL Maths and Physics (or 33 with 5 in HL Maths and Physics + B in EE); Physics MPhys IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths and Physics (or 34 with 6,5 + A in EE); Chemistry BSc / Chemistry MChem IB 34 with 5 in HL Chemistry (or 33 + B in EE); Biological Sciences BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in HL Biology and a second science (or 33 + A in a science-based EE); Biomedical Science BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in two HL science subjects; Psychology BSc IB 34 with 5 in a HL science subject; Data Science BSc IB 34 (or 33 with A in a science-based EE); Economics BSc IB 34 with 5 in HL Maths (or 33 + B in EE); Business Management BA / Accounting and Financial Management BA IB 34 (or 33 with A in the EE); Law LLB IB 36 (or 34 with A in the EE); Medicine MBChB IB 36 with 6 in three HL subjects including Chemistry or Biology and a second science, and no less than 4 in all SL subjects; Dental Surgery BDS IB 36 with 6 in HL Chemistry and Biology; Nursing (Adult) BMedSci IB 32; Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering MEng IB 38 with 6 in HL Maths and at least one of Physics/Chemistry/Biology (or 36 with + A in a science-based EE for Mechanical); Civil and Structural / Electrical and Electronic / Chemical / Materials Science and Engineering / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6,5 in HL Maths and a science + A/B in the EE); Architecture BA IB 36 (or 34 + A in the EE) plus portfolio and GCSE Maths grade 4/C; Landscape Architecture BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE) plus portfolio; Journalism Studies BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Digital Media and Society / Sociology BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Politics and International Relations / Criminology BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Geography BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Urban Studies and Planning MPlan(UG) IB 33 (or 32 with B in a social-science based EE) plus GCSE Maths grade 4/C; English Literature BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); History BA and Philosophy BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Modern Languages and Cultures BA IB 33 typically with 5 in a HL modern foreign language (or 32 with B in the EE). Where IB offers are a range, the lower bound is conditional on the Extended Essay / additional HL grade as stated on the course page. GCSE English Language and GCSE Maths grade 4/C or above (some courses higher) are typically required; many Engineering and Psychology courses require GCSE Maths grade 6/B or 5/B. Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (Sheffield Undergraduate tuition fees 2027 page: 'The standard annual undergraduate tuition fee for home fee-paying students starting their course in 2027 is GBP 10,050').
universities.english_requirement_default: Standard Sheffield undergraduate band is IELTS Academic grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 4/C (most course pages 'For this course we require: GCSE English Language at grade 4/C; IELTS grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component'). Law LLB, English Literature BA and Modern Languages and Cultures BA require IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component. Journalism Studies BA and Medicine MBChB require IELTS 7.5 with minimum 7.0 in each component; Medicine also requires GCSE English Language at grade 6/B. Dental Surgery BDS requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 7/A. Nursing (Adult) BMedSci requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in Speaking, Reading and Listening, and 6.5 in Writing, plus GCSE English Language grade 4/C. IB English equivalencies on Sheffield English language requirements for undergraduates page: 'International Baccalaureate (IB) Standard or Higher Level English A: Language and Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard Level English B Grade 6 or above; IB Higher Level English B Grade 5 or above.' Alternatives: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert Academic SELT, Trinity ISE III/IV; pre-sessional English at the University ELTC and International Foundation Year / International Year One at the University of Sheffield International College meet the requirement.
universities.admission_default: Applications for full-time undergraduate courses are made through UCAS; University of Sheffield UCAS institution code S18 (code name SHEFD; Sheffield Undergraduate Apply page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 for all courses except Medicine and Dentistry (Sheffield Undergraduate Applying essentials page: 'Applications for courses starting in September 2027 (except Medicine and Dentistry) should be submitted to UCAS between: 1 September 2026 and 13 January 2027 to be guaranteed equal consideration'; 'Applications for places on Medicine and Dentistry courses must be submitted between 1 September and 15 October 2026'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200) UCAS 2027-entry deadline Thursday 15 October 2026. UCAT (University Clinical Aptitude Test) taken in the year of application required for Medicine MBChB and Dental Surgery BDS; Medicine selection also includes an interview stage; Dental Surgery mentions UCAT used in conjunction with the existing selection procedure. LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT listed in the Sheffield Law LLB course page Other requirements. Portfolio of artistic ability required for Architecture BA and Landscape Architecture BA. STEP, STEP 2 or STEP 3 at grade 3 or above gives additional consideration for Mathematics BSc but is not considered in place of a third A Level. GCSE English Language 4/C and GCSE Maths 4/C typical (some courses higher: Medicine and Dentistry GCSE English 7/A or 6/B, many Engineering courses GCSE Maths 6/B, Psychology BSc GCSE Maths 5/B, Business Management BA and Accounting and Financial Management BA GCSE Maths 6/B, Civil and Structural Engineering MEng GCSE Physics 6/B, Materials Science and Engineering MEng GCSE Maths 6/B and 4/C in Physics and Chemistry, Urban Studies and Planning MPlan GCSE Maths 4/C). Contextual offers via Access Sheffield equivalent to one or two grades below the standard A Level requirements. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International per-year tuition printed on each course fee lookup for 2027-28 (e.g. GBP 27,650 Business Management BA; GBP 29,570 Law LLB, Data Science BSc, Geography BA, Urban Planning MPlan, Journalism Studies BA; GBP 32,340 Mathematics BSc, Financial Mathematics BSc; GBP 34,670 Computer Science BSc, Computer Science (AI), Physics BSc/MPhys, Chemistry BSc/MChem, Biological Sciences BSc, Biomedical Science BSc, Psychology BSc, all Engineering MEng, Architecture BA; GBP 51,380 per year Medicine MBChB; GBP 55,000 per year Dental Surgery BDS). International (overseas) fee NOT printed on the course fee lookup for Nursing (Adult) BMedSci (overseas=null on the 2027 fee API). Sheffield offers a fixed-fee guarantee for international students on courses longer than one year: 'International students will pay the same fixed annual tuition fee for each year of the same course.'

programmes.other_requirements: Admission via national IMAT (International Medical Admissions Test) regulated by MUR. Minimum eligibility score for EU candidates is 20 points (out of 90); non-EU candidates residing abroad must score >0 points. For 2026/27 (last year's figure; 2027/28 not yet published), there were 55 seats for EU and EU-equivalent candidates and 61 seats for non-EU candidates residing abroad (total 116 seats); IMAT test date was 29 September 2026.
