translations.en: UCAS application; equal consideration deadline 13 Jan 2027 for 2027 entry (15 Oct 2026 for Medicine); no admissions tests except UCAT for Medicine (with interview); tuition_eu is the RUK fee for 2027/28 (Scotland fee £1,820, SAAS-paid for eligible Scottish students); international fees vary by school (typically £31,100 classroom / £40,900 lab-based; Medicine £59,700).
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS; termín equal consideration 13. januára 2027 na nástup v roku 2027 (15. októbra 2026 pre Medicine); žiadne prijímacie testy okrem UCAT pre Medicine (s pohovorom); tuition_eu je poplatok RUK na 2027/28 (poplatok pre Škótsko £1,820, ktorý za oprávnených škótskych študentov platí SAAS); medzinárodné poplatky sa líšia podľa fakulty (zvyčajne £31,100 za odbory v učebniach / £40,900 za laboratórne odbory; Medicine £59,700).

translations.en: UCAS application; equal consideration deadline 13 Jan 2027 18:00 UK (15 Oct 2026 18:00 UK for Medicine/Dentistry). UCAT mandatory for Medicine and Dentistry; LNAT for Law LLB and Politics, Philosophy & Law LLB; interviews for Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing and Quantitative Mathematics. tuition_eu is the published 2026/27 Home fee GBP 9,790 (2027/28 Home fee not yet published as of 2026-10-28); international fees shown per course for September 2027 entry range GBP 30,750-66,800 (arts/humanities 30,750-35,900; most sciences 40,600-45,400; Medicine 60,200; Dentistry 66,800).
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS; termín equal consideration 13. januára 2027 18:00 UK (15. októbra 2026 18:00 UK pre Medicine/Dentistry). UCAT je povinný pre Medicine a Dentistry; LNAT pre Law LLB a Politics, Philosophy & Law LLB; pohovory pre Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing a Quantitative Mathematics. tuition_eu je zverejnený poplatok Home na 2026/27 GBP 9,790 (poplatok Home na 2027/28 k 2026-10-28 ešte nebol zverejnený); medzinárodné poplatky uvedené pri jednotlivých odboroch pre nástup v septembri 2027 sú v rozmedzí GBP 30,750-66,800 (umelecké/humanitné odbory 30,750-35,900; väčšina prírodných vied 40,600-45,400; Medicine 60,200; Dentistry 66,800).

translations.en: UCAS application. For 2027 entry, equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 at 6pm GMT; 15 October 2026 at 6pm GMT for Medicine and Dentistry (Manchester how-to-apply page). UCAT + interview mandatory for Medicine (SJT Band 3-4 not considered) and Dentistry; Nursing shortlists applicants for interview. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 stated across Manchester 2027 course pages; international 2027/28 fees on published course pages range GBP 29,200 (classroom-based) to GBP 41,900 (Materials Science and Engineering); Medicine/Dentistry pages publish 2026/27 figures (Home GBP 9,535; international GBP 38,300-39,900 pre-clinical).
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS. Na nástup v roku 2027 je termín equal consideration 13. januára 2027 o 18:00 GMT (6pm); 15. októbra 2026 o 18:00 GMT (6pm) pre Medicine a Dentistry (stránka Manchester how-to-apply). UCAT + pohovor sú povinné pre Medicine (SJT Band 3-4 sa neakceptuje) a Dentistry; pri Nursing sa robí užší výber uchádzačov na pohovor. tuition_eu je zverejnený poplatok Home na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 uvedený na stránkach odborov Manchester pre 2027; medzinárodné poplatky na 2027/28 na zverejnených stránkach odborov sú od GBP 29,200 (odbory v učebniach) do GBP 41,900 (Materials Science and Engineering); stránky Medicine/Dentistry uvádzajú sumy na 2026/27 (Home GBP 9,535; medzinárodný GBP 38,300-39,900 v predklinickej časti).

translations.en: UCAS application; equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for 2027 entry (Bristol apply/dates page — page prints "13 January 2026" [sic; UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration date is 13 January 2027]) and 15 October 2026 for Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Science. UCAT + interview (Nov-Apr) + DBS check for Medicine and Dentistry; LNAT for Law LLB; mandatory vacation Extra-Mural Studies (EMS) for Veterinary Science. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 (Bristol fees page: "2027/28: £10,050 (confirmed)"); international 2027-entry fees on course pages range GBP 26,500 (Law, Philosophy, Politics and International Relations) to GBP 51,600 (Dentistry); most classroom courses GBP 29,300, most lab courses GBP 32,500-34,700, Medicine GBP 47,600, Veterinary Science GBP 43,500.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS; termín equal consideration 13. januára 2027 na nástup v roku 2027 (stránka Bristol apply/dates — stránka uvádza "13 January 2026" [sic; termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027]) a 15. októbra 2026 pre Medicine, Dentistry a Veterinary Science. UCAT + pohovor (november–apríl) + DBS kontrola pre Medicine a Dentistry; LNAT pre Law LLB; povinná prázdninová prax Extra-Mural Studies (EMS) pre Veterinary Science. tuition_eu je zverejnený poplatok Home na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 (stránka Bristol fees: "2027/28: £10,050 (confirmed)"); medzinárodné poplatky na nástup v roku 2027 na stránkach odborov sú od GBP 26,500 (Law, Philosophy, Politics and International Relations) do GBP 51,600 (Dentistry); väčšina odborov v učebniach GBP 29,300, väčšina laboratórnych odborov GBP 32,500-34,700, Medicine GBP 47,600, Veterinary Science GBP 43,500.

translations.en: UCAS application; UCAS 2027 equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 at 18:00 (Warwick Key dates page). Warwick does not typically interview applicants. Admissions tests (Warwick TMUA page): TMUA required for Computer Science (G400 BSc / G403 MEng / GN42 BSc CS-Business / G190 BSc Discrete / G4G3 MEng Discrete, not for Computer Systems Engineering); TMUA or STEP required for Mathematics (G100 BSc / G103 MMath); TMUA 5.0 or STEP grade 2 included as one optional route in most offers for Statistics family (GG13 BSc MathStat / GGC3 MMathStat / GLN0 BSc MORSE / G0L0 MMORSE / 7G73 BSc Data Science / G304 MSci Data Science); TMUA optional-but-encouraged for Economics family (L100 BSc Economics / LLD2 EPAIS / LN12 Economics and Management). Law LLB: "Our Law programmes do not currently require the LNAT for admissions consideration." Home fee (tuition_eu) 2027-28 = GBP 10,050 (Warwick Fees page). Overseas 2026-27 fees: Band 1 £27,870 (classroom-based, Humanities, most Social Science) / Band 2 £35,530 (laboratory, Mathematics, Statistics, Theatre and Performance Studies, Economics, WBS); 2027-28 Overseas fees not yet published.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS; termín equal consideration UCAS 2027 je 13. januára 2027 o 18:00 (stránka Warwick Key dates). Warwick uchádzačov zvyčajne nepozýva na pohovor. Prijímacie testy (stránka Warwick TMUA): TMUA je povinný pre Computer Science (G400 BSc / G403 MEng / GN42 BSc CS-Business / G190 BSc Discrete / G4G3 MEng Discrete, nie pre Computer Systems Engineering); TMUA alebo STEP je povinný pre Mathematics (G100 BSc / G103 MMath); TMUA 5.0 alebo STEP so známkou 2 je vo väčšine ponúk pre skupinu Statistics jednou z nepovinných ciest (GG13 BSc MathStat / GGC3 MMathStat / GLN0 BSc MORSE / G0L0 MMORSE / 7G73 BSc Data Science / G304 MSci Data Science); TMUA je nepovinný, ale odporúčaný pre skupinu Economics (L100 BSc Economics / LLD2 EPAIS / LN12 Economics and Management). Law LLB: "Our Law programmes do not currently require the LNAT for admissions consideration." Poplatok Home (tuition_eu) 2027-28 = GBP 10,050 (stránka Warwick Fees). Poplatky Overseas 2026-27: Band 1 £27,870 (odbory v učebniach, Humanities, väčšina Social Science) / Band 2 £35,530 (laboratórne odbory, Mathematics, Statistics, Theatre and Performance Studies, Economics, WBS); poplatky Overseas na 2027-28 ešte nie sú zverejnené.

translations.en: UCAS application; UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Durham How to Apply page: "you'll need to apply by the January UCAS Equal Consideration Date"). LNAT required for Law LLB; TMUA strongly encouraged (optional) for Mathematics G100/G103, where a suitable TMUA or STEP performance may reduce the offer. No Medicine, Dentistry or Veterinary programmes at Durham. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 (Durham Tuition Fees page: "The tuition fee level for home students starting their course in 2026/27 is £9,790. This tuition fee will increase to £10,050 in 2027/28."). International 2027/28 fees shown on course pages: humanities and social sciences GBP 29,500-30,000, Law GBP 31,000, Business School and Mathematics GBP 32,500, Geography GBP 33,000, Computer Science GBP 35,000, laboratory sciences and Engineering GBP 36,000.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS; termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027 (stránka Durham How to Apply: "you'll need to apply by the January UCAS Equal Consideration Date"). LNAT je povinný pre Law LLB; TMUA sa dôrazne odporúča (je nepovinný) pre Mathematics G100/G103, kde vhodný výsledok TMUA alebo STEP môže znížiť podmienky ponuky. Durham nemá programy Medicine, Dentistry ani Veterinary. tuition_eu je zverejnený poplatok Home na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 (stránka Durham Tuition Fees: "The tuition fee level for home students starting their course in 2026/27 is £9,790. This tuition fee will increase to £10,050 in 2027/28."). Medzinárodné poplatky na 2027/28 uvedené na stránkach odborov: humanitné a spoločenské vedy GBP 29,500-30,000, Law GBP 31,000, Business School a Mathematics GBP 32,500, Geography GBP 33,000, Computer Science GBP 35,000, laboratórne vedy a Engineering GBP 36,000.

translations.en: UCAS application. UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027, printed as both Home and Overseas application deadlines on all 2027 course pages. No Medicine, Dentistry or Veterinary degrees at Bath; the professional undergraduate entry is Pharmacy MPharm, which requires a selection interview (overseas applicants interviewed remotely), an Enhanced DBS check in the first semester and a Fitness to Practise self-declaration (GPhC). Architecture: 'We will usually assess you based on your UCAS application and we do not consider portfolios.' Mathematical Sciences degrees: 'we do not consider additional Maths tests such as STEP, MAT or TMUA as part of our admissions process.' Home fee (tuition_eu) is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 (Bath 'Tuition fees for undergraduate students starting in 2027' page; UK regulated fee, subject to parliamentary approval). Overseas 2027/28 band fees from the same page: Band 1 library-based Humanities & Social Sciences GBP 26,150 (exceptions: Economics-related courses and Sport and Exercise Science/Psychology priced elsewhere); Band 2 Economics (and related) and School of Management courses GBP 29,500 (incl. BSc International Management and Modern Languages, BSc Economics, BSc Economics and Mathematics); Band 3 all Science, Engineering, Health and Psychology courses GBP 32,950. 2027 course pages print 'Fee information is not yet available for this course', so figures are taken from the central schedule; reduced placement-year fees apply (Humanities & Social Sciences GBP 7,265; School of Management GBP 14,750; Engineering/Science/Health/Psychology GBP 9,155). Overseas fees may rise by up to 8% per year.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS. Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027 a na všetkých stránkach odborov pre 2027 je uvedený ako termín prihlášok pre Home aj Overseas. Bath nemá odbory Medicine, Dentistry ani Veterinary; profesijným bakalárskym odborom je Pharmacy MPharm, ktorý vyžaduje výberový pohovor (uchádzači zo zahraničia ho majú na diaľku), kontrolu Enhanced DBS v prvom semestri a čestné vyhlásenie Fitness to Practise (GPhC). Architecture: 'We will usually assess you based on your UCAS application and we do not consider portfolios.' Odbory Mathematical Sciences: 'we do not consider additional Maths tests such as STEP, MAT or TMUA as part of our admissions process.' Poplatok Home (tuition_eu) je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 (stránka Bath 'Tuition fees for undergraduate students starting in 2027'; regulovaný poplatok v UK, podlieha schváleniu parlamentom). Poplatky Overseas na 2027/28 podľa pásiem z tej istej stránky: Band 1 Humanities & Social Sciences (library-based) GBP 26,150 (výnimky: odbory súvisiace s ekonómiou a Sport and Exercise Science/Psychology sú zaradené inde); Band 2 Economics (a súvisiace odbory) a odbory School of Management GBP 29,500 (vrátane BSc International Management and Modern Languages, BSc Economics, BSc Economics and Mathematics); Band 3 všetky odbory Science, Engineering, Health a Psychology GBP 32,950. Stránky odborov pre 2027 uvádzajú 'Fee information is not yet available for this course', preto sú sumy z centrálneho sadzobníka; za rok praxe (placement year) platia znížené poplatky (Humanities & Social Sciences GBP 7,265; School of Management GBP 14,750; Engineering/Science/Health/Psychology GBP 9,155). Poplatky Overseas môžu stúpať až o 8% ročne.

translations.en: UCAS application (UCAS name STA, number code S36); overseas students may instead use the Common Application or a Direct Application. Equal consideration deadline for all MA and BSc undergraduate applications: 6pm (GMT) Wednesday 13 January 2027; Medicine: 6pm (GMT) Thursday 15 October 2026. Personal statement and academic reference required; most applicants are not interviewed (exceptions: Medicine, supported pathway programmes, part-time study). Applicants from other countries should use the Standard entry requirements; Standard, Minimum and Gateway levels are explained on the academic entry explained page.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS (názov v UCAS STA, kód S36); zahraniční študenti môžu namiesto toho použiť Common Application alebo Direct Application. Termín equal consideration pre všetky bakalárske prihlášky MA a BSc: 18:00 GMT (6pm) v stredu 13. januára 2027; Medicine: 18:00 GMT (6pm) vo štvrtok 15. októbra 2026. Vyžaduje sa motivačný text (personal statement) a akademické odporúčanie; väčšina uchádzačov nemá pohovor (výnimky: Medicine, programy supported pathway, štúdium popri práci (part-time)). Uchádzači z iných krajín sa majú riadiť požiadavkami Standard entry requirements; úrovne Standard, Minimum a Gateway vysvetľuje stránka academic entry explained.

translations.en: UCAS application. UCAS equal consideration deadlines printed on Glasgow how-to-apply date page: 18:00 (UK) Wednesday 13 January 2027 for most programmes; 18:00 (UK) Thursday 15 October 2026 for Medicine (A100), Dentistry (A200/A203) and Veterinary Medicine (D100). UCAT mandatory for Medicine MBChB and Dentistry BDS; interview follows for shortlisted applicants (Multiple Mini-Interview for Veterinary Medicine). LNAT (National Admissions Test for Law) mandatory for Scots Law LLB. No other admissions tests for the undergraduate programmes researched; the standard offer is released after UCAS review without a mandatory interview for most Arts, Social Sciences and STEM programmes. Glasgow International College provides a foundation route into year 2 for applicants who narrowly miss entry requirements.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS. Termíny equal consideration UCAS uvedené na stránke Glasgow how-to-apply s termínmi: 18:00 (UK) v stredu 13. januára 2027 pre väčšinu programov; 18:00 (UK) vo štvrtok 15. októbra 2026 pre Medicine (A100), Dentistry (A200/A203) a Veterinary Medicine (D100). UCAT je povinný pre Medicine MBChB a Dentistry BDS; uchádzači v užšom výbere potom idú na pohovor (pri Veterinary Medicine Multiple Mini-Interview). LNAT (National Admissions Test for Law) je povinný pre Scots Law LLB. Pri preverených bakalárskych programoch nie sú žiadne ďalšie prijímacie testy; štandardnú ponuku pri väčšine programov Arts, Social Sciences a STEM pošlú po posúdení prihlášky UCAS bez povinného pohovoru. Glasgow International College ponúka prípravnú cestu (foundation) do 2. ročníka pre uchádzačov, ktorým tesne chýba splnenie vstupných požiadaviek.

translations.en: UCAS application for all full-time courses (University of Exeter UCAS code E84 EXETR). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Exeter Applying via UCAS page: applications should reach UCAS between 1 September and the UCAS equal consideration deadline; applications received after this date considered if places are still available). Medicine BMBS applicants must apply between 1 September and 15 October 2026; UCAT or GAMSAT mandatory for all BMBS applicants (interview follows for shortlisted applicants). No other admissions tests for the undergraduate courses researched; offers are released after UCAS review without a mandatory interview for most programmes. Contextual offers published per course (example based on offers made to students starting in 2022). Exeter International Foundation course provides a route into Year 1 for applicants who narrowly miss entry requirements.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS pre všetky denné odbory (UCAS kód University of Exeter E84 EXETR). Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027 (stránka Exeter Applying via UCAS: prihlášky majú do UCAS prísť medzi 1. septembrom a termínom equal consideration UCAS; prihlášky prijaté po tomto termíne sa posudzujú, ak sú ešte voľné miesta). Uchádzači o Medicine BMBS sa musia prihlásiť medzi 1. septembrom a 15. októbrom 2026; UCAT alebo GAMSAT je povinný pre všetkých uchádzačov o BMBS (uchádzači v užšom výbere potom idú na pohovor). Pri preverených bakalárskych odboroch nie sú žiadne ďalšie prijímacie testy; ponuky pri väčšine programov pošlú po posúdení prihlášky UCAS bez povinného pohovoru. Kontextové ponuky (contextual offers) sú zverejnené pri každom odbore (príklad podľa ponúk pre študentov, ktorí začali v roku 2022). Kurz Exeter International Foundation ponúka cestu do 1. ročníka pre uchádzačov, ktorým tesne chýba splnenie vstupných požiadaviek.

translations.en: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses. UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Leeds Application timetable page); applications received after the deadline are considered if places remain. Medicine and Surgery MBChB applicants must apply by 15 October 2026 and take the UCAT; shortlisted applicants are interviewed (selection also uses 8 GCSEs). Fine Art BA requires a portfolio of work; applicants already on a Level-3 Fine Art pathway or Access to Leeds are exempt. Law LLB does not require LNAT. English Literature, History and Philosophy BA note that an interview and a piece of written work 'may be required'. No STEP, MAT, TMUA or other admissions tests are listed for the remaining undergraduate courses researched - selection is on UCAS application plus GCSE prerequisites. Home fee (tuition_eu) is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 ('Tuition fees for UK undergraduate students starting in 2027/28 are GBP 10,050'; UK regulated cap subject to parliamentary approval). Overseas 2027/28 fee bands printed on course pages (per year, unchanged for duration of the course): GBP 27,300 (Politics BA, International Relations BA, Global Development BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Communication and Media BA, Fine Art BA); GBP 27,600 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Economics, Economics and Finance, Business Management, International Business); GBP 30,400 (Mathematics, Actuarial Mathematics, Geography BA/BSc); GBP 31,300 (Accounting and Finance); GBP 33,700 (Computer Science, Physics MPhys,BSc, Chemistry MChem,BSc, all engineering MEng,BEng courses, Food Science, Nutrition); GBP 33,800 (Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Psychology); GBP 50,500 (Medicine and Surgery MBChB). Reduced fees apply for study-abroad/work-placement years (UK GBP 1,505; international GBP 4,575).
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS pre všetky denné bakalárske odbory. Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027 (stránka Leeds Application timetable); prihlášky prijaté po termíne sa posudzujú, ak zostanú voľné miesta. Uchádzači o Medicine and Surgery MBChB sa musia prihlásiť do 15. októbra 2026 a urobiť UCAT; uchádzači v užšom výbere majú pohovor (pri výbere sa zohľadňuje aj 8 GCSE). Fine Art BA vyžaduje portfólio prác; uchádzači, ktorí už sú na Level-3 Fine Art pathway alebo v Access to Leeds, sú od neho oslobodení. Law LLB nevyžaduje LNAT. Pri English Literature, History a Philosophy BA sa uvádza, že pohovor a písomná práca 'may be required'. Pri ostatných preverených bakalárskych odboroch nie sú uvedené STEP, MAT, TMUA ani iné prijímacie testy - výber prebieha na základe prihlášky UCAS a požiadaviek na GCSE. Poplatok Home (tuition_eu) je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 ('Tuition fees for UK undergraduate students starting in 2027/28 are GBP 10,050'; regulovaný strop v UK, podlieha schváleniu parlamentom). Pásma poplatkov Overseas na 2027/28 uvedené na stránkach odborov (ročne, nemenné počas celého štúdia): GBP 27,300 (Politics BA, International Relations BA, Global Development BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Communication and Media BA, Fine Art BA); GBP 27,600 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Economics, Economics and Finance, Business Management, International Business); GBP 30,400 (Mathematics, Actuarial Mathematics, Geography BA/BSc); GBP 31,300 (Accounting and Finance); GBP 33,700 (Computer Science, Physics MPhys,BSc, Chemistry MChem,BSc, všetky inžinierske odbory MEng,BEng, Food Science, Nutrition); GBP 33,800 (Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Psychology); GBP 50,500 (Medicine and Surgery MBChB). Za rok štúdia v zahraničí/praxe platia znížené poplatky (UK GBP 1,505; medzinárodný GBP 4,575).

translations.en: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses (University of Birmingham UCAS campus code B32). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (Birmingham How to apply for undergraduate study page). UCAS 2027-entry deadline for Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200): Thursday 15 October 2026. Admissions tests: UCAT in year of application plus interview required for Medicine MBChB and Dentistry BDS; LNAT is NOT required for Law LLB (course page: "We do not require or consider the LNAT admissions test for entry onto our programmes"). No TMUA, MAT, STEP or other admissions test listed for other undergraduate courses; Engineering applicants without A-level Mathematics may be asked to sit a Birmingham Mathematics Aptitude test. Music BMus may require an audition/interview for applicants without the standard Music qualification; ABRSM Grade 8 Performance or Grade 6 Theory accepted as alternative. Additional reductions: contextual offers (typically one grade lower), Pathways to Birmingham (typically two grades lower), EPQ alternative offer (one grade lower plus grade B in EPQ; excludes Medicine A100 and Dentistry A200), Core Maths alternative offer for selected programmes (excludes programmes with A-level Mathematics requirement), Music performance Grade 8 alternative offer, county-level sport alternative offer. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year tuition printed per course: GBP 24,840 (Politics BA, International Relations BA); GBP 25,320 (Modern Languages BA); GBP 26,220 (Law LLB, Sociology BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Ancient History and Archaeology BA); GBP 27,300 (English Literature BA); GBP 28,680 (Economics, Money Banking and Finance, Business Management, Marketing); GBP 30,180 (Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Finance, Pharmacy MPharm, Nursing Adult BNurs); GBP 31,680 (Materials Science and Engineering MEng); GBP 33,300 (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, all engineering MEng courses except Materials); Medicine MBChB international GBP 33,750 per year for pre-clinical years 1-2 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 3-5; Dentistry BDS international GBP 30,180 for pre-clinical year 1 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 2-5. International fees for Biological Sciences BSc, Human Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Sport Exercise and Health Sciences BSc, Geography BSc and Environmental Science BSc are listed as "To be confirmed" on the course pages at the time of verification.
translations.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS pre všetky denné bakalárske odbory (UCAS kód kampusu University of Birmingham B32). Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je v stredu 13. januára 2027 (stránka Birmingham How to apply for undergraduate study). Termín UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 pre Medicine (A100) a Dentistry (A200): štvrtok 15. októbra 2026. Prijímacie testy: UCAT v roku podania prihlášky plus pohovor sú povinné pre Medicine MBChB a Dentistry BDS; LNAT sa pre Law LLB NEVYŽADUJE (stránka odboru: "We do not require or consider the LNAT admissions test for entry onto our programmes"). Pri ostatných bakalárskych odboroch nie je uvedený TMUA, MAT, STEP ani iný prijímací test; uchádzačov o Engineering bez A-level Mathematics môžu požiadať, aby urobili Birmingham Mathematics Aptitude test. Music BMus môže od uchádzačov bez štandardnej hudobnej kvalifikácie vyžadovať prehrávku/pohovor; ako alternatíva sa uznáva ABRSM Grade 8 Performance alebo Grade 6 Theory. Ďalšie zníženia: kontextové ponuky (zvyčajne o jednu známku nižšie), Pathways to Birmingham (zvyčajne o dve známky nižšie), alternatívna ponuka s EPQ (o jednu známku nižšie plus známka B z EPQ; neplatí pre Medicine A100 a Dentistry A200), alternatívna ponuka s Core Maths pre vybrané programy (neplatí pre programy s požiadavkou A-level Mathematics), alternatívna ponuka za hudobný výkon Grade 8, alternatívna ponuka za šport na úrovni grófstva (county). Školné Home na 2027/28: GBP 10,050 ročne. Medzinárodné ročné školné na 2027/28 uvedené pri odboroch: GBP 24,840 (Politics BA, International Relations BA); GBP 25,320 (Modern Languages BA); GBP 26,220 (Law LLB, Sociology BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Ancient History and Archaeology BA); GBP 27,300 (English Literature BA); GBP 28,680 (Economics, Money Banking and Finance, Business Management, Marketing); GBP 30,180 (Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Finance, Pharmacy MPharm, Nursing Adult BNurs); GBP 31,680 (Materials Science and Engineering MEng); GBP 33,300 (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, všetky inžinierske odbory MEng okrem Materials); Medicine MBChB medzinárodné GBP 33,750 ročne v predklinických ročníkoch 1-2 a GBP 53,880 ročne v klinických ročníkoch 3-5; Dentistry BDS medzinárodné GBP 30,180 v predklinickom 1. ročníku a GBP 53,880 ročne v klinických ročníkoch 2-5. Medzinárodné poplatky pre Biological Sciences BSc, Human Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Sport Exercise and Health Sciences BSc, Geography BSc a Environmental Science BSc sú v čase overenia na stránkach odborov uvedené ako "To be confirmed".

translations.en: All full-time undergraduate applications are made through UCAS; University of Southampton UCAS institution code S27 (code name SOTON; Southampton Apply through UCAS page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications for most undergraduate courses'). Medicine BM5 (A100) UCAS deadline Thursday 15 October 2026 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications to the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, and for most courses in medicine, dentistry, and veterinary medicine/science'; BM5 course page: 'All applicants must sit the UCAT test before the 15th October UCAS deadline'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Selection: UCAT required for Medicine BM5 with ranking to interview (BM5 course page 'Selection to Interview: All applicants who meet the entry requirements through either achieved or predicted grades at the point of application are ranked by UCAT score and the top number of applicants invited to interview'); portfolio is required for art courses only (Southampton Apply through UCAS page: 'you may also be asked to submit a portfolio. This is typically for Arts courses such as: BA Hons Graphic Arts, BA Fine Art, BA Games, Design and Art'); LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT required for Southampton Law LLB (Law LLB course page Non-academic entry requirements: 'LNAT is not required for our programmes'). Age requirement: applicants must be 18 or over at the start of Medicine BM5 (course page 'Applicants must be 18 or over at the start of the course'). Physics BSc/MPhys applicants may be invited for an optional departmental interview which may lower the offer (Physics course pages 'The optional interview may lead to a lower offer'). Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year rates printed per course: GBP 27,500 (English BA, Two Modern Languages BA); GBP 28,300 (Archaeology BA, History BA, Economics BSc, Economics and Actuarial Science BSc, Business Management BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc); GBP 28,400 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Film Studies BA); GBP 29,800 (Mathematics BSc, Mathematics with Actuarial Science BSc); GBP 31,000 (Biomedical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,000 (Computer Science BSc, Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence MEng, Software Engineering MEng); GBP 33,500 (Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Maritime/Acoustical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,900 (Biology BSc, Biomedical Sciences BSc, Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Oceanography BSc, Physical Geography BSc); GBP 34,100 (Physics BSc, Physics MPhys, Chemistry BSc, Chemistry MChem); Medicine BM5 BMBS international GBP 35,900 per year.
translations.sk: Všetky prihlášky na denné bakalárske odbory sa podávajú cez UCAS; kód inštitúcie UCAS University of Southampton S27 (kódový názov SOTON; stránka Southampton Apply through UCAS). Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je v stredu 13. januára 2027 (stránka UCAS Dates and deadlines: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications for most undergraduate courses'). Termín UCAS pre Medicine BM5 (A100) je vo štvrtok 15. októbra 2026 (stránka UCAS Dates and deadlines: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications to the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, and for most courses in medicine, dentistry, and veterinary medicine/science'; stránka odboru BM5: 'All applicants must sit the UCAT test before the 15th October UCAS deadline'). Prihlášky UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 sa otvárajú v septembri 2026. Výber: pre Medicine BM5 je povinný UCAT, podľa ktorého sa určuje poradie na pohovor (stránka odboru BM5 'Selection to Interview: All applicants who meet the entry requirements through either achieved or predicted grades at the point of application are ranked by UCAT score and the top number of applicants invited to interview'); portfólio sa vyžaduje len pri umeleckých odboroch (stránka Southampton Apply through UCAS: 'you may also be asked to submit a portfolio. This is typically for Arts courses such as: BA Hons Graphic Arts, BA Fine Art, BA Games, Design and Art'); LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) sa pre Southampton Law LLB NEVYŽADUJE (stránka odboru Law LLB, Non-academic entry requirements: 'LNAT is not required for our programmes'). Veková požiadavka: uchádzači musia mať na začiatku štúdia Medicine BM5 aspoň 18 rokov (stránka odboru 'Applicants must be 18 or over at the start of the course'). Uchádzačov o Physics BSc/MPhys môžu pozvať na nepovinný pohovor na katedre, ktorý môže znížiť podmienky ponuky (stránky odborov Physics 'The optional interview may lead to a lower offer'). Školné Home na 2027/28: GBP 10,050 ročne. Medzinárodné ročné sadzby na 2027/28 uvedené pri odboroch: GBP 27,500 (English BA, Two Modern Languages BA); GBP 28,300 (Archaeology BA, History BA, Economics BSc, Economics and Actuarial Science BSc, Business Management BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc); GBP 28,400 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Film Studies BA); GBP 29,800 (Mathematics BSc, Mathematics with Actuarial Science BSc); GBP 31,000 (Biomedical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,000 (Computer Science BSc, Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence MEng, Software Engineering MEng); GBP 33,500 (Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Maritime/Acoustical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,900 (Biology BSc, Biomedical Sciences BSc, Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Oceanography BSc, Physical Geography BSc); GBP 34,100 (Physics BSc, Physics MPhys, Chemistry BSc, Chemistry MChem); Medicine BM5 BMBS medzinárodné GBP 35,900 ročne.

translations.en: Applications for full-time undergraduate courses are made through UCAS; University of Sheffield UCAS institution code S18 (code name SHEFD; Sheffield Undergraduate Apply page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 for all courses except Medicine and Dentistry (Sheffield Undergraduate Applying essentials page: 'Applications for courses starting in September 2027 (except Medicine and Dentistry) should be submitted to UCAS between: 1 September 2026 and 13 January 2027 to be guaranteed equal consideration'; 'Applications for places on Medicine and Dentistry courses must be submitted between 1 September and 15 October 2026'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200) UCAS 2027-entry deadline Thursday 15 October 2026. UCAT (University Clinical Aptitude Test) taken in the year of application required for Medicine MBChB and Dental Surgery BDS; Medicine selection also includes an interview stage; Dental Surgery mentions UCAT used in conjunction with the existing selection procedure. LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT listed in the Sheffield Law LLB course page Other requirements. Portfolio of artistic ability required for Architecture BA and Landscape Architecture BA. STEP, STEP 2 or STEP 3 at grade 3 or above gives additional consideration for Mathematics BSc but is not considered in place of a third A Level. GCSE English Language 4/C and GCSE Maths 4/C typical (some courses higher: Medicine and Dentistry GCSE English 7/A or 6/B, many Engineering courses GCSE Maths 6/B, Psychology BSc GCSE Maths 5/B, Business Management BA and Accounting and Financial Management BA GCSE Maths 6/B, Civil and Structural Engineering MEng GCSE Physics 6/B, Materials Science and Engineering MEng GCSE Maths 6/B and 4/C in Physics and Chemistry, Urban Studies and Planning MPlan GCSE Maths 4/C). Contextual offers via Access Sheffield equivalent to one or two grades below the standard A Level requirements. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International per-year tuition printed on each course fee lookup for 2027-28 (e.g. GBP 27,650 Business Management BA; GBP 29,570 Law LLB, Data Science BSc, Geography BA, Urban Planning MPlan, Journalism Studies BA; GBP 32,340 Mathematics BSc, Financial Mathematics BSc; GBP 34,670 Computer Science BSc, Computer Science (AI), Physics BSc/MPhys, Chemistry BSc/MChem, Biological Sciences BSc, Biomedical Science BSc, Psychology BSc, all Engineering MEng, Architecture BA; GBP 51,380 per year Medicine MBChB; GBP 55,000 per year Dental Surgery BDS). International (overseas) fee NOT printed on the course fee lookup for Nursing (Adult) BMedSci (overseas=null on the 2027 fee API). Sheffield offers a fixed-fee guarantee for international students on courses longer than one year: 'International students will pay the same fixed annual tuition fee for each year of the same course.'
translations.sk: Prihlášky na denné bakalárske odbory sa podávajú cez UCAS; kód inštitúcie UCAS University of Sheffield S18 (kódový názov SHEFD; stránka Sheffield Undergraduate Apply). Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je v stredu 13. januára 2027 pre všetky odbory okrem Medicine a Dentistry (stránka Sheffield Undergraduate Applying essentials: 'Applications for courses starting in September 2027 (except Medicine and Dentistry) should be submitted to UCAS between: 1 September 2026 and 13 January 2027 to be guaranteed equal consideration'; 'Applications for places on Medicine and Dentistry courses must be submitted between 1 September and 15 October 2026'). Prihlášky UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 sa otvárajú v septembri 2026. Termín UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 pre Medicine (A100) a Dentistry (A200) je vo štvrtok 15. októbra 2026. UCAT (University Clinical Aptitude Test) urobený v roku podania prihlášky je povinný pre Medicine MBChB a Dental Surgery BDS; výber na Medicine zahŕňa aj pohovor; pri Dental Surgery sa uvádza, že UCAT sa používa spolu s existujúcim výberovým konaním. LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) NIE JE uvedený v časti Other requirements na stránke odboru Sheffield Law LLB. Pre Architecture BA a Landscape Architecture BA sa vyžaduje portfólio, ktoré ukáže umelecké schopnosti. STEP, STEP 2 alebo STEP 3 so známkou 3 alebo lepšou sa pri Mathematics BSc zohľadní navyše, ale nenahrádza tretí A Level. Typicky GCSE English Language 4/C a GCSE Maths 4/C (niektoré odbory viac: Medicine a Dentistry GCSE English 7/A alebo 6/B, mnohé odbory Engineering GCSE Maths 6/B, Psychology BSc GCSE Maths 5/B, Business Management BA a Accounting and Financial Management BA GCSE Maths 6/B, Civil and Structural Engineering MEng GCSE Physics 6/B, Materials Science and Engineering MEng GCSE Maths 6/B a 4/C z Physics a Chemistry, Urban Studies and Planning MPlan GCSE Maths 4/C). Kontextové ponuky cez Access Sheffield zodpovedajú požiadavkám o jednu alebo dve známky nižším, než sú štandardné požiadavky A Level. Školné Home na 2027/28: GBP 10,050 ročne. Medzinárodné ročné školné uvedené vo vyhľadávači poplatkov pri každom odbore na 2027-28 (napr. GBP 27,650 Business Management BA; GBP 29,570 Law LLB, Data Science BSc, Geography BA, Urban Planning MPlan, Journalism Studies BA; GBP 32,340 Mathematics BSc, Financial Mathematics BSc; GBP 34,670 Computer Science BSc, Computer Science (AI), Physics BSc/MPhys, Chemistry BSc/MChem, Biological Sciences BSc, Biomedical Science BSc, Psychology BSc, všetky Engineering MEng, Architecture BA; GBP 51,380 ročne Medicine MBChB; GBP 55,000 ročne Dental Surgery BDS). Medzinárodný (overseas) poplatok NIE JE uvedený vo vyhľadávači poplatkov pre Nursing (Adult) BMedSci (overseas=null v API poplatkov na 2027). Sheffield ponúka medzinárodným študentom na odboroch dlhších ako jeden rok garanciu pevného poplatku: 'International students will pay the same fixed annual tuition fee for each year of the same course.'

translations.en: St Andrews English Profile 1-D (School of English): IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with 7.0 in each component. No test needed with an English-medium secondary/high-school leaving qualification (final two years at a school with a substantial English-language educational environment, including at least one subject with a substantial component of writing in English; IB English-medium schools meet this requirement).
translations.sk: St Andrews English Profile 1-D (School of English): IELTS Academic celkovo 7.5 a 7.0 z každej časti. Test netreba, ak máš doklad o ukončení strednej školy s výučbou v angličtine (posledné dva roky na škole s výrazne anglickým vzdelávacím prostredím, vrátane aspoň jedného predmetu s podstatnou časťou písania v angličtine; IB školy s výučbou v angličtine túto podmienku spĺňajú).

translations.en: Exeter English Profile G (listed on course page: "The required test scores for this course fall under Profile G"). IB route: IB English as a First Language Language A: Literature or Language A: Language and Literature Grade 5 at SL or Grade 4 at HL; Language B: English Grade 7 at SL or Grade 6 at HL. Otherwise IELTS Academic 7.5 with no less than 7.0 in any section.
translations.sk: Exeter English Profile G (uvedené na stránke programu: "The required test scores for this course fall under Profile G"). Cez IB: IB English ako prvý jazyk, Language A: Literature alebo Language A: Language and Literature so známkou 5 na SL alebo 4 na HL; Language B: English so známkou 7 na SL alebo 6 na HL. Inak IELTS Academic 7.5 a v žiadnej časti menej ako 7.0.

translations.en: IELTS 7.5 overall, with no less than 7.5 in Spoken English (course page; Medicine-specific band). IB route (Leeds English language equivalent qualifications page): English A (first language) Literature or Language and Literature grade 4 at HL or SL; English B (second language) grade 5 at HL or 6 at SL; English B SL not accepted for courses with IELTS requirement 7.0+.
translations.sk: IELTS celkovo 7.5, z hovorenia (Spoken English) aspoň 7.5 (stránka programu; úroveň špecifická pre medicínu). Cez IB (stránka Leeds o rovnocenných kvalifikáciách z angličtiny): English A (prvý jazyk) Literature alebo Language and Literature so známkou 4 na HL alebo SL; English B (druhý jazyk) so známkou 5 na HL alebo 6 na SL; English B SL sa neuznáva pre programy s požiadavkou IELTS 7.0+.

translations.en: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any band (course page). TOEFL iBT: 88 overall, no less than 21 in Reading, 20 in Listening, 22 in Speaking and 21 in Writing (pre-Jan 2026); 4.5 overall with no less than 4.5 in any skill (tests taken from Jan 2026).
translations.sk: IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5, v žiadnej časti menej ako 6.0 (stránka programu). TOEFL iBT: celkovo 88, aspoň 21 z čítania, 20 z počúvania, 22 z hovorenia a 21 z písania (pred januárom 2026); celkovo 4.5, v žiadnej zručnosti menej ako 4.5 (testy od januára 2026).

translations.en: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in any band (course page). TOEFL iBT: 95 overall with no less than 22 in any band (pre-Jan 2026).

translations.en: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with no less than 7.0 in any band (course page). TOEFL iBT: 95 overall with no less than 23 in any band.

translations.en: IELTS Academic overall score 7.0, with minimum 7.0 in reading, 7.0 in writing, 7.0 in speaking and 7.0 in listening (course page IELTS score requirements — BM5 band is higher than the standard Southampton band). Pre-sessional English programmes offered where the IELTS requirement is not met (course page English language requirements). GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above is typically required, or an equivalent accepted by the University.
translations.sk: IELTS Academic celkovo 7.0, minimálne 7.0 z čítania, 7.0 z písania, 7.0 z hovorenia a 7.0 z počúvania (stránka programu, požiadavky na skóre IELTS — úroveň BM5 je vyššia ako štandardná úroveň Southamptonu). Ak požiadavku IELTS nesplníš, ponúkajú prípravné kurzy angličtiny (pre-sessional) (stránka programu, jazykové požiadavky). Zvyčajne sa vyžaduje GCSE English Language (alebo GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics so známkou 4/C alebo vyššou, alebo ekvivalent, ktorý univerzita uznáva.

translations.en: IELTS Academic overall score 6.5, with minimum 6.5 in reading, 6.5 in writing, 6.5 in speaking and 6.5 in listening (course page IELTS score requirements). Pre-sessional English programmes offered where the IELTS requirement is not met (course page English language requirements). GCSE English language requirement: 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University.' IB English route not separately listed on the course page; English qualifications equivalencies live on Southampton's English language pages. Note Law LLB carries a HIGHER band than the standard Southampton LLB-adjacent band — all four components at 6.5 (course page IELTS score requirements).
translations.sk: IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5, minimálne 6.5 z čítania, 6.5 z písania, 6.5 z hovorenia a 6.5 z počúvania (stránka programu, požiadavky na skóre IELTS). Ak požiadavku IELTS nesplníš, ponúkajú prípravné kurzy angličtiny (pre-sessional) (stránka programu, jazykové požiadavky). Požiadavka GCSE z angličtiny: 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University.' Cesta cez IB English nie je na stránke programu uvedená zvlášť; rovnocenné kvalifikácie z angličtiny sú na stránkach Southamptonu o anglickom jazyku. Poznámka: Law LLB má VYŠŠIU úroveň ako štandardná úroveň Southamptonu pre príbuzné programy k LLB — všetky štyri časti na 6.5 (stránka programu, požiadavky na skóre IELTS).

translations.en: GCSE English Language at grade 6/B; IELTS grade of 7.5 with a minimum of 7.0 in each component; or an alternative acceptable English language qualification. (course page English language requirements). IB English equivalencies published on Sheffield English language requirements for undergraduates page: IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Language and Literature Grade 4+; IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Literature Grade 4+; IB Standard Level English B Grade 6+; IB Higher Level English B Grade 5+.
translations.sk: GCSE English Language so známkou 6/B; IELTS 7.5, minimálne 7.0 z každej časti; alebo iná uznávaná kvalifikácia z angličtiny. (stránka programu, jazykové požiadavky). Rovnocenné výsledky IB z angličtiny uvádza Sheffield na stránke o jazykových požiadavkách pre bakalárske štúdium: IB English A: Language and Literature na Standard alebo Higher Level so známkou 4+; IB English A: Literature na Standard alebo Higher Level so známkou 4+; IB English B na Standard Level so známkou 6+; IB English B na Higher Level so známkou 5+.
