translations.sk: IB celkovo 38-40 vrátane bodov za core, so 6 a 7 na HL (podľa programu).

translations.en: IB 41-42 typical offer with 776 at Higher Level; subject-specific HL requirements per course (e.g. Maths HL for STEM).
translations.sk: IB 41-42 ako typická ponuka so 776 na Higher Level; požiadavky na konkrétne HL predmety podľa programu (napr. Maths HL pre STEM).

translations.en: IB 38-41 typical offer with HL 6s and 7s (course-specific). Maths HL required for most courses (AA preferred).
translations.sk: IB 38-41 ako typická ponuka so 6 a 7 na HL (podľa programu). Väčšina programov vyžaduje Maths HL (prednosť má AA).

translations.en: IB 37-39 points overall with 666-766 at higher level; HL Mathematics (often grade 7, some courses require Analysis and Approaches) required for quantitative courses.
translations.sk: IB celkovo 37-39 bodov so 666-766 na higher level; kvantitatívne programy vyžadujú HL Mathematics (často so známkou 7, niektoré programy vyžadujú Analysis and Approaches).

translations.en: IB 36-40 points overall with 17-20 points in three HL subjects (no HL score below 5); HL 7 in Mathematics (AA or AI) required for quantitative courses; Mathematics BSc requires AA only.
translations.sk: IB celkovo 36-40 bodov a 17-20 bodov z troch HL predmetov (žiadna HL známka pod 5); kvantitatívne programy vyžadujú HL 7 z Mathematics (AA alebo AI); Mathematics BSc vyžaduje iba AA.

translations.en: Programme-specific IB Diploma offers published as ranges with required HL/SL subjects (e.g. from 43 points with 777 at HL to 34 points with 665 at HL for Informatics); SL English at 5 required for entry to all degrees (ab initio not accepted).
translations.sk: Ponuky pre IB diplom sú zverejnené pre každý program zvlášť ako rozpätia s povinnými HL/SL predmetmi (napr. od 43 bodov so 777 na HL po 34 bodov so 665 na HL pre Informatics); na všetky programy treba SL English so známkou 5 (ab initio sa neuznáva).

translations.en: IB 31-39 points overall per course (e.g. Nursing with Registration 31; Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence 39 with grade 6 in HL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches); HL subject requirements per course.
translations.sk: IB celkovo 31-39 bodov podľa programu (napr. Nursing with Registration 31; Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence 39 so známkou 6 z HL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches); požiadavky na HL predmety podľa programu.

translations.en: IB 30-38 points overall with specific HL subjects per course (e.g. Adult Nursing 30 with 5,5,4 at HL incl at least one science-related subject; Politics/Geography-family 35-36 with 6,6,5-6,6,6 at HL; Law/CS/Electrical & Electronic 37 with 7,6,6; Mechanical Engineering 38 with 7,7,6). Maths options policy varies per course (AA-only for CS, Mathematics, Chemical Engineering; AA or AI for Physics and most Engineering).
translations.sk: IB celkovo 30-38 bodov s konkrétnymi HL predmetmi podľa programu (napr. Adult Nursing 30 s 5,5,4 na HL vrátane aspoň jedného prírodovedného predmetu; programy typu Politics/Geography 35-36 s 6,6,5-6,6,6 na HL; Law/CS/Electrical & Electronic 37 so 7,6,6; Mechanical Engineering 38 so 7,7,6). Pravidlá pre voľbu matematiky sa líšia podľa programu (len AA pre CS, Mathematics, Chemical Engineering; AA alebo AI pre Physics a väčšinu inžinierskych programov).

translations.en: IB typically 34-40 points overall with 17-18 at Higher Level per course (e.g. English/Geography/Cellular and Molecular Medicine 34 with 17 at HL; most sciences, Law-family and business courses 36 with 18 at HL; Computer Science/Physics/Psychology/Economics/Law 38 with 18 at HL; Mathematics, Economics and Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science 40). HL subject requirements per course; Mathematics courses accept HL Mathematics either Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations (HL 6-7 typical); Economics-family courses also accept 7 at SL Analysis and Approaches. Contextual offers published per course (typically 2-4 points lower).
translations.sk: IB zvyčajne celkovo 34-40 bodov a 17-18 na Higher Level podľa programu (napr. English/Geography/Cellular and Molecular Medicine 34 a 17 na HL; väčšina prírodných vied, programy typu Law a obchodné programy 36 a 18 na HL; Computer Science/Physics/Psychology/Economics/Law 38 a 18 na HL; Mathematics, Economics and Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science 40). Požiadavky na HL predmety podľa programu; programy z matematiky uznávajú buď HL Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, alebo Applications and Interpretations (zvyčajne HL 6-7); programy typu Economics uznávajú aj 7 zo SL Analysis and Approaches. Kontextové ponuky sú zverejnené pri každom programe (zvyčajne o 2-4 body nižšie).

translations.en: IB typically 32-39 points overall per course. English Literature/History/Philosophy 36; Film and Television Studies/Modern Languages 32; Biomedical Science/Biochemistry/Chemistry 34; Accounting and Finance/Economics/Economics and Management/EPAIS/PPE/Law LLB/Management/International Management 38; Engineering MEng (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/Automotive/Systems) 38 including 6,6,6 HL in Mathematics and Physics; Physics BSc/Mathematics and Physics 38 including 7 in HL Mathematics (AA only); Data Science/MORSE/Mathematics and Statistics 38-39 by route with HL Maths (AA or AI) 6-7 and TMUA 5.0/STEP 2/AEA Distinction as one option; Computer Science/Discrete Mathematics 39 with 7,6,6 including 7 in HL Mathematics (AA only); Mathematics BSc/MMath 39 with 6 HL Mathematics (AA only) plus TMUA or STEP. Contextual offers 2-4 points lower at every course.
translations.sk: IB zvyčajne celkovo 32-39 bodov podľa programu. English Literature/History/Philosophy 36; Film and Television Studies/Modern Languages 32; Biomedical Science/Biochemistry/Chemistry 34; Accounting and Finance/Economics/Economics and Management/EPAIS/PPE/Law LLB/Management/International Management 38; Engineering MEng (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/Automotive/Systems) 38 vrátane 6,6,6 na HL z Mathematics a Physics; Physics BSc/Mathematics and Physics 38 vrátane 7 z HL Mathematics (len AA); Data Science/MORSE/Mathematics and Statistics 38-39 podľa cesty, s HL Maths (AA alebo AI) 6-7 a ako jednou z možností TMUA 5.0/STEP 2/AEA Distinction; Computer Science/Discrete Mathematics 39 so 7,6,6 vrátane 7 z HL Mathematics (len AA); Mathematics BSc/MMath 39 so 6 z HL Mathematics (len AA) plus TMUA alebo STEP. Kontextové ponuky sú pri každom programe o 2-4 body nižšie.

translations.en: IB typically 35-38 points overall per course. Accounting and Finance, Anthropology, Business and Management, Criminology, Sociology, Theology and Religion 35 (665 HL); Biological Sciences, Classics, Geography BSc (666 or 765), International Relations, Modern Languages and Cultures, Philosophy, Politics, Psychology 36; Chemistry BSc/MChem, Computer Science, Economics BSc, Economics with Management, English Literature, General Engineering MEng, Geography BA, History, Law LLB, Natural Sciences, PPE 37; Mathematics BSc/MMath, Physics BSc/MPhys 38. HL subject requirements per course: Mathematics, Physics and Natural Sciences require 7-6 in HL Mathematics Analysis & Approaches; Chemistry explicitly accepts either AA or AI at HL; Economics/engineering pages require HL Mathematics without specifying AA/AI; PPE accepts SL Mathematics grade 7 instead of HL; Accounting and Finance, Business and Management and Psychology add GCSE-level Mathematics requirements. Contextual offers 2-3 grades lower published per course.
translations.sk: IB zvyčajne celkovo 35-38 bodov podľa programu. Accounting and Finance, Anthropology, Business and Management, Criminology, Sociology, Theology and Religion 35 (665 na HL); Biological Sciences, Classics, Geography BSc (666 alebo 765), International Relations, Modern Languages and Cultures, Philosophy, Politics, Psychology 36; Chemistry BSc/MChem, Computer Science, Economics BSc, Economics with Management, English Literature, General Engineering MEng, Geography BA, History, Law LLB, Natural Sciences, PPE 37; Mathematics BSc/MMath, Physics BSc/MPhys 38. Požiadavky na HL predmety podľa programu: Mathematics, Physics a Natural Sciences vyžadujú 7-6 z HL Mathematics Analysis & Approaches; Chemistry výslovne uznáva na HL buď AA, alebo AI; stránky Economics a inžinierskych programov vyžadujú HL Mathematics bez určenia AA/AI; PPE uznáva namiesto HL aj SL Mathematics so známkou 7; Accounting and Finance, Business and Management a Psychology pridávajú požiadavky z matematiky na úrovni GCSE. Kontextové ponuky o 2-3 známky nižšie sú zverejnené pri každom programe.

translations.en: IB offers for 2027 entry: 35 points overall with 6,6,5 or 6,5,5 at Higher Level for Pharmacy MPharm (B230), Sociology and Social Policy, Criminology and Modern Languages BA; 36 points overall for all other published undergraduate offers, with HL patterns from 6,6,5 (Chemistry, Biology, Management-family) through 7,6,6 to 7,7,6 in three Higher Level subjects including essential subjects (Computer Science 7,7,6 incl. 6 in either HL Mathematics; Mechanical/Aerospace/Integrated Design Engineering MEng 7,7,6 incl. 6 in Physics and 7 in either HL Mathematics). Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches at Higher Level is compulsory for Mathematics, Mathematics and Statistics and Economics and Mathematics (Applications & Interpretations not accepted); most other quantitative courses accept either HL Mathematics course, and several publish Standard Level AA (grade 6-7) alternative routes. GCSE Mathematics requirements (grade 4/C to 7/A by course) are met by any IB Higher or Standard Level Mathematics: 'We accept any IB Higher or Standard Level in English or Mathematics as meeting our essential GCSE requirements' (Bath qualification guidance page). Contextual offers published per course (typically 6,6,6 or 7,6,5 HL).
translations.sk: Ponuky pre IB na nástup v roku 2027: celkovo 35 bodov so 6,6,5 alebo 6,5,5 na Higher Level pre Pharmacy MPharm (B230), Sociology and Social Policy, Criminology a Modern Languages BA; celkovo 36 bodov pre všetky ostatné zverejnené bakalárske ponuky, s kombináciami na HL od 6,6,5 (Chemistry, Biology, programy typu Management) cez 7,6,6 po 7,7,6 z troch predmetov na Higher Level vrátane povinných predmetov (Computer Science 7,7,6 vrátane 6 z ktorejkoľvek HL Mathematics; Mechanical/Aerospace/Integrated Design Engineering MEng 7,7,6 vrátane 6 z Physics a 7 z ktorejkoľvek HL Mathematics). Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches na Higher Level je povinná pre Mathematics, Mathematics and Statistics a Economics and Mathematics (Applications & Interpretations sa neuznáva); väčšina ostatných kvantitatívnych programov uznáva ktorýkoľvek z dvoch HL kurzov matematiky a viaceré zverejňujú alternatívne cesty cez Standard Level AA (známka 6-7). Požiadavky na GCSE Mathematics (známka 4/C až 7/A podľa programu) spĺňa akákoľvek IB Mathematics na Higher alebo Standard Level: 'We accept any IB Higher or Standard Level in English or Mathematics as meeting our essential GCSE requirements' (stránka Bath s informáciami o kvalifikáciách). Kontextové ponuky sú zverejnené pri každom programe (zvyčajne 6,6,6 alebo 7,6,5 na HL).

translations.en: Scottish four-year degrees. IB Diploma 2027-entry offers are published per course as Standard and Minimum entry grades: Standard 38 (HL 6,6,6) for Computer Science (incl. HL6 Mathematics + SL5 in a listed science), Mathematics BSc/MMath, Statistics, Physics BSc/MPhys, Astrophysics MPhys (physics degrees incl. HL6 Mathematics and Physics), Chemistry BSc/MChem (incl. HL6 Chemistry + HL6 in one listed science), Geography, Sustainable Development, Economics, Financial Economics, Management, International Relations, History (incl. HL6 History) and English (incl. HL6 English); Standard 36 (HL 6,6,5) for Biology, Marine Biology, Biochemistry (HL6 Biology + HL6 Chemistry), Neuroscience (HL5 in two of Biology/Chemistry/Mathematics/Physics), Psychology, Classics, Art History, Social Anthropology, Film Studies, French (incl. French B HL6 or French A SL7) and Theological Studies. Minimum entry grades are 36 (HL 6,5,5) across courses; Gateway programmes support contextual applicants who narrowly miss Minimum grades. General entry requirements (or IB equivalent) for every course: SQA National 5 (B)/GCSE (5) in English plus one listed science/mathematics subject. tuition_eu is the 2027-entry RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Republic of Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man) rate GBP 10,050 per year printed on 2027 course pages ("yet to be confirmed by the UK Government"); Home (Scotland) fee TBC by the Scottish Government (2025-2026 was GBP 1,820, SAAS-paid for eligible Scottish students). International (EU and overseas) 2027-entry fee GBP 34,910 per year for Faculty of Arts, Divinity and Science degrees; Medicine 2026-2027 entrant fee GBP 39,620. No admissions tests for the undergraduate courses researched; interviews only for Medicine, Gateway/supported pathway programmes and part-time study. Direct entry to second year possible for well-qualified applicants in many science degrees.
translations.sk: Škótske štvorročné programy. Ponuky pre IB diplom na nástup v roku 2027 sú zverejnené pre každý program ako Standard a Minimum entry grades: Standard 38 (HL 6,6,6) pre Computer Science (vrátane HL6 Mathematics + SL5 z jedného z uvedených prírodovedných predmetov), Mathematics BSc/MMath, Statistics, Physics BSc/MPhys, Astrophysics MPhys (fyzikálne programy vrátane HL6 Mathematics a Physics), Chemistry BSc/MChem (vrátane HL6 Chemistry + HL6 z jedného uvedeného prírodovedného predmetu), Geography, Sustainable Development, Economics, Financial Economics, Management, International Relations, History (vrátane HL6 History) a English (vrátane HL6 English); Standard 36 (HL 6,6,5) pre Biology, Marine Biology, Biochemistry (HL6 Biology + HL6 Chemistry), Neuroscience (HL5 z dvoch z predmetov Biology/Chemistry/Mathematics/Physics), Psychology, Classics, Art History, Social Anthropology, Film Studies, French (vrátane French B HL6 alebo French A SL7) a Theological Studies. Minimum entry grades sú pri všetkých programoch 36 (HL 6,5,5); programy Gateway podporujú kontextových uchádzačov, ktorým Minimum grades tesne chýbajú. Všeobecné vstupné požiadavky (alebo ich IB ekvivalent) pre každý program: SQA National 5 (B)/GCSE (5) z angličtiny plus jeden uvedený prírodovedný/matematický predmet. tuition_eu je sadzba RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Republic of Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man) na nástup v roku 2027, GBP 10,050 ročne, uvedená na stránkach programov pre rok 2027 ("yet to be confirmed by the UK Government"); poplatok Home (Scotland) zatiaľ nepotvrdila Scottish Government (v rokoch 2025-2026 bol GBP 1,820, hradí ho SAAS pre oprávnených škótskych študentov). Medzinárodný poplatok (EU a zámorie) na nástup v roku 2027 je GBP 34,910 ročne pre programy Faculty of Arts, Divinity a Science; Medicine pre študentov nastupujúcich v 2026-2027 GBP 39,620. Pri preskúmaných bakalárskych programoch nie sú prijímacie testy; pohovory len pre Medicine, programy Gateway/supported pathway a štúdium popri práci (part-time). Dobre pripraveným uchádzačom je pri mnohých prírodovedných programoch možný priamy vstup do druhého ročníka.

translations.en: Scottish four-year degrees (many MA (Hons) and MA (SocSci) programmes, BSc in sciences and engineering; some degrees route into MSci or MEng for strong students). IB Diploma 2027-entry offers are published per course as "IB standard entry requirements" of the form "NN (HL a,b,c)": 38 (6,6,6) for Computing Science, Software Engineering MEng, Mechanical/Aeronautical/Civil/Electronic & Electrical/Biomedical Engineering MEng, Medicine MBChB, Veterinary Medicine & Surgery BVMS and Psychology BSc (upper bound); 36 (6,6,6) for Dentistry BDS; 36 (6,6,5) for Business & Management MA (SocSci), Economics MA (SocSci), Politics MA (Hons) and Sociology MA (SocSci); 34 (6,5,5) for Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Physics with Astrophysics MPhys, Genetics, Zoology, Neuroscience and English Literature MA (Hons); 32 (5,5,5) for Chemistry and Geography BSc; 32 (6,5,5) lower bound for History/Philosophy/Classics/French/Film & Television Studies/Archaeology MA (Hons) and International Relations MA (SocSci). Several programmes quote a range (e.g. Psychology "38 (6,6,6 HL) - 34 (6,5,5 HL)"; Scots Law LLB and International Relations "38 - 32/34"). HL subject requirements per course: Mathematics (Analysis & Approaches) HL 6 required for Computing Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Chemistry and all Engineering routes; HL Biology or Chemistry for Life Sciences; HL Chemistry and HL Biology plus UCAT for Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Medicine; HL English (or Humanities) plus LNAT for Scots Law LLB. Where a programme spans both BEng and MEng, the printed IB offer is "BEng 34 (6,5,5); MEng 38 (6,6,6)". tuition_eu is the published RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland) 2026/27 standard fee GBP 9,790; the 2027/28 RUK standard fee is not yet published on Glasgow live fees pages. Scotland fee is GBP 1,820 (SAAS-paid for eligible Scottish students). International 2027/28 fees printed on Glasgow international fees page: Arts and Social Sciences programmes GBP 28,275; Science, Engineering, Nursing and College of Medical, Veterinary and Life Sciences programmes GBP 33,708; Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) GBP 60,255; Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine and Surgery (BVMS) GBP 38,670; MBChB and CMVLS clinical programmes GBP 67,112. Note: live Glasgow course pages currently serve the IB offer only through a JavaScript country selector; the IB figures above are endorsed from Wayback captures of Glasgow 2026/27 course pages (2025-09/2025-10 snapshots), as flagged in each row's deadline_notes.
translations.sk: Škótske štvorročné programy (mnohé programy MA (Hons) a MA (SocSci), BSc v prírodných vedách a inžinierstve; niektoré programy vedú silných študentov k MSci alebo MEng). Ponuky pre IB diplom na nástup v roku 2027 sú zverejnené pre každý program ako "IB standard entry requirements" v tvare "NN (HL a,b,c)": 38 (6,6,6) pre Computing Science, Software Engineering MEng, Mechanical/Aeronautical/Civil/Electronic & Electrical/Biomedical Engineering MEng, Medicine MBChB, Veterinary Medicine & Surgery BVMS a Psychology BSc (horná hranica); 36 (6,6,6) pre Dentistry BDS; 36 (6,6,5) pre Business & Management MA (SocSci), Economics MA (SocSci), Politics MA (Hons) a Sociology MA (SocSci); 34 (6,5,5) pre Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Physics with Astrophysics MPhys, Genetics, Zoology, Neuroscience a English Literature MA (Hons); 32 (5,5,5) pre Chemistry a Geography BSc; 32 (6,5,5) ako dolná hranica pre History/Philosophy/Classics/French/Film & Television Studies/Archaeology MA (Hons) a International Relations MA (SocSci). Viaceré programy uvádzajú rozpätie (napr. Psychology "38 (6,6,6 HL) - 34 (6,5,5 HL)"; Scots Law LLB a International Relations "38 - 32/34"). Požiadavky na HL predmety podľa programu: Mathematics (Analysis & Approaches) HL 6 sa vyžaduje pre Computing Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Chemistry a všetky inžinierske programy; HL Biology alebo Chemistry pre Life Sciences; HL Chemistry a HL Biology plus UCAT pre Medicine, Dentistry a Veterinary Medicine; HL English (alebo humanitný predmet) plus LNAT pre Scots Law LLB. Ak program zahŕňa BEng aj MEng, uvedená ponuka pre IB je "BEng 34 (6,5,5); MEng 38 (6,6,6)". tuition_eu je zverejnený štandardný poplatok RUK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland) na 2026/27 GBP 9,790; štandardný poplatok RUK na 2027/28 zatiaľ nie je zverejnený na aktuálnych stránkach Glasgow o poplatkoch. Poplatok pre Škótsko je GBP 1,820 (hradí ho SAAS pre oprávnených škótskych študentov). Medzinárodné poplatky na 2027/28 zo stránky Glasgow o medzinárodných poplatkoch: programy Arts and Social Sciences GBP 28,275; programy Science, Engineering, Nursing a College of Medical, Veterinary and Life Sciences GBP 33,708; Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) GBP 60,255; Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine and Surgery (BVMS) GBP 38,670; MBChB a klinické programy CMVLS GBP 67,112. Poznámka: aktuálne stránky programov v Glasgow zobrazujú ponuku pre IB len cez výber krajiny v JavaScripte; uvedené údaje pre IB sú prevzaté zo záznamov stránok programov Glasgow 2026/27 vo Wayback (snímky 2025-09/2025-10), ako je označené v deadline_notes každého riadku.

translations.en: IB offers for 2027 entry are published per course as total points with Higher Level grade slips: 38/766 for BMBS Medicine (HL 6 in Chemistry and HL 6 in Biology, plus UCAT or GAMSAT); 38/766-36/666 for BSc Economics and BSc Economics and Finance (HL5 or SL6 in Mathematics AA or AI; Maths Studies not accepted); 36/666 for LLB Law and BSc Psychology (HL6 in a Science subject); 36/666-34/665 for BSc Computer Science (HL5 Mathematics AA or AI), BSc Mathematics and BSc Mathematics with Economics (HL6 Mathematics AA only), BSc Geography (HL5 in a science subject), BSc Physics (36/666-32/655; HL6 Mathematics AA and HL5 Physics, or HL5 Mathematics AA and HL6 Physics); 34/665-32/655 for MEng Mechanical Engineering and MEng Renewable Energy Engineering (HL5 Mathematics AA or AI plus HL5 in another science subject); 34/665 for BA Politics, BA International Relations, BA History, BA English (HL5 in an accepted Humanities or Social Science subject) and Business School BScs (Business and Management, Marketing and Management, Accounting and Finance; GCSE B/5 Mathematics or A-Level Maths route); 34/665-32/655 for BSc Environmental Science and BSc Exercise and Sport Sciences (HL5 in a science subject); 32/655 for BSc Biological Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 another Science), BSc Biomedical Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 another accepted Science), BSc Neuroscience (HL5 in two Science subjects), BSc Zoology, BSc Marine Biology (HL5 in a science subject), BSc/BA Classics and BA Film & Television Studies; 32/655-30/555 for BA/BSc Sociology, BSc Criminology, BA Archaeology and BA Modern Languages (language requirement depends on language level chosen). GCSE grade C/4 in English Language required across courses; some science and business courses also require GCSE B/5 or 6 in Mathematics (Maths Transition Course route may apply if one grade below). Contextual offers typically 2-4 points lower, quoted on course pages as an example based on 2022 entry. tuition_eu is Exeter's published 2027/28 Home standard fee £10,050 ("it is the University of Exeter's intention to charge the revised standard tuition fee of £10,050 per year... for each year of your studies"; BMBS Medicine years one to four at the standard fee, year five paid by the NHS assuming current funding arrangements). tuition_noneu is the published 2027/28 international fee printed on course pages: £25,700 Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (including Law) and Accounting, Finance, Business & Management, Economics and Marketing; £31,500 Computer Science, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Ecology and Conservation, Engineering, Geology, Geography, Mathematics and Statistics, Medical Imaging, Natural Sciences, Neuroscience, Nursing, Physics, Sport and Health Sciences; £32,150 Biosciences, Biomedical Sciences, Psychology; £49,300 BMBS Medicine (Exeter 2027 fees page; fees "expected to increase modestly in line with Consumer Price Index... in each year of study").
translations.sk: Ponuky pre IB na nástup v roku 2027 sú zverejnené pre každý program ako celkový počet bodov s kombináciou známok na Higher Level: 38/766 pre BMBS Medicine (HL 6 z Chemistry a HL 6 z Biology, plus UCAT alebo GAMSAT); 38/766-36/666 pre BSc Economics a BSc Economics and Finance (HL5 alebo SL6 z Mathematics AA alebo AI; Maths Studies sa neuznáva); 36/666 pre LLB Law a BSc Psychology (HL6 z prírodovedného predmetu); 36/666-34/665 pre BSc Computer Science (HL5 Mathematics AA alebo AI), BSc Mathematics a BSc Mathematics with Economics (HL6 Mathematics len AA), BSc Geography (HL5 z prírodovedného predmetu), BSc Physics (36/666-32/655; HL6 Mathematics AA a HL5 Physics, alebo HL5 Mathematics AA a HL6 Physics); 34/665-32/655 pre MEng Mechanical Engineering a MEng Renewable Energy Engineering (HL5 Mathematics AA alebo AI plus HL5 z ďalšieho prírodovedného predmetu); 34/665 pre BA Politics, BA International Relations, BA History, BA English (HL5 z uznávaného humanitného alebo spoločenskovedného predmetu) a BSc programy Business School (Business and Management, Marketing and Management, Accounting and Finance; GCSE B/5 Mathematics alebo cesta cez A-Level Maths); 34/665-32/655 pre BSc Environmental Science a BSc Exercise and Sport Sciences (HL5 z prírodovedného predmetu); 32/655 pre BSc Biological Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 z ďalšieho prírodovedného predmetu), BSc Biomedical Sciences (HL5 Biology plus HL5 z ďalšieho uznávaného prírodovedného predmetu), BSc Neuroscience (HL5 z dvoch prírodovedných predmetov), BSc Zoology, BSc Marine Biology (HL5 z prírodovedného predmetu), BSc/BA Classics a BA Film & Television Studies; 32/655-30/555 pre BA/BSc Sociology, BSc Criminology, BA Archaeology a BA Modern Languages (jazyková požiadavka závisí od zvolenej úrovne jazyka). Na všetky programy treba GCSE English Language so známkou C/4; niektoré prírodovedné a obchodné programy vyžadujú aj GCSE Mathematics so známkou B/5 alebo 6 (ak ti chýba jedna známka, môže prichádzať do úvahy cesta cez Maths Transition Course). Kontextové ponuky sú zvyčajne o 2-4 body nižšie, na stránkach programov uvedené ako príklad podľa nástupu v roku 2022. tuition_eu je zverejnený štandardný poplatok Home v Exeteri na 2027/28 £10,050 ("it is the University of Exeter's intention to charge the revised standard tuition fee of £10,050 per year... for each year of your studies"; BMBS Medicine prvý až štvrtý ročník za štandardný poplatok, piaty ročník hradí NHS za predpokladu súčasných pravidiel financovania). tuition_noneu je zverejnený medzinárodný poplatok na 2027/28 uvedený na stránkach programov: £25,700 Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (vrátane Law) a Accounting, Finance, Business & Management, Economics a Marketing; £31,500 Computer Science, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Ecology and Conservation, Engineering, Geology, Geography, Mathematics and Statistics, Medical Imaging, Natural Sciences, Neuroscience, Nursing, Physics, Sport and Health Sciences; £32,150 Biosciences, Biomedical Sciences, Psychology; £49,300 BMBS Medicine (stránka Exeter o poplatkoch na 2027; poplatky sa "expected to increase modestly in line with Consumer Price Index... in each year of study").

translations.en: IB offers for 2027 entry are published per course either as a Higher Level slip ('18 points at Higher level', '17 points at Higher Level', '6,6,5 at HL') or as a total plus HL slip. Engineering (Mechanical, Electronic & Electrical, Civil, Aeronautical/Aerospace MEng,BEng) and Computer Science BSc publish 18 points at HL with 6 in HL Mathematics AA or 5 in HL Mathematics AI (Civil inverts the grades); Chemical Engineering MEng,BEng slips at 15 HL points. Mathematics BSc and Actuarial Mathematics BSc publish 17 points at HL including 6 in HL Mathematics (AA preferred). Physics MPhys,BSc publishes 18 HL points (HL 5 Physics + HL 5 Maths). Chemistry MChem,BSc slips at 6,6,5 HL including Chemistry. Biology/Biomedical Sciences/Neuroscience publish a total of 31 overall with 6,6,5 HL including Biology and another science. Psychology BSc publishes 35 overall with a HL science at grade 6 plus GCSE Maths grade 5 (B) or IB SL equivalent. Leeds University Business School - Economics BSc, Economics and Finance BSc, Business Management BA, International Business BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc - all publish 35 overall with 17 HL points plus Maths via SL 5 or HL 4 and English via SL/HL or through another qualification. Law LLB: 35 overall (6,6,5 HL). Medicine and Surgery MBChB: 36 overall with 6 in each of 3 HL subjects including Chemistry and Biology; SL 5 in English and Maths if not at GCSE. Geography BA slips 18 HL; Geography BSc slips 6,6,5 HL including an accepted subject. Politics BA, International Relations BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA and Communication and Media BA publish 35 overall / 16 HL (English Literature, Philosophy, Media and Communication add an English grade condition). Global Development BA and Sociology BA publish 34 overall (6,5,5 HL). Fine Art BA publishes 34 overall with 16 HL and 4 in English. Food Science BSc and Nutrition BSc publish 6,5,5 HL including two science subjects. GCSE English Language grade 4 (C) is required across courses (GCSE Maths grade 4 for Food Science, Nutrition and some Business programmes). Contextual Access to Leeds offers typically 1-2 grades lower at A-level.
translations.sk: Ponuky pre IB na nástup v roku 2027 sú zverejnené pre každý program buď ako kombinácia na Higher Level ('18 points at Higher level', '17 points at Higher Level', '6,6,5 at HL'), alebo ako celkový počet bodov plus kombinácia na HL. Engineering (Mechanical, Electronic & Electrical, Civil, Aeronautical/Aerospace MEng,BEng) a Computer Science BSc uvádzajú 18 bodov na HL so 6 z HL Mathematics AA alebo 5 z HL Mathematics AI (pri Civil sú známky naopak); Chemical Engineering MEng,BEng má 15 bodov na HL. Mathematics BSc a Actuarial Mathematics BSc uvádzajú 17 bodov na HL vrátane 6 z HL Mathematics (prednosť má AA). Physics MPhys,BSc uvádza 18 bodov na HL (HL 5 Physics + HL 5 Maths). Chemistry MChem,BSc má 6,6,5 na HL vrátane Chemistry. Biology/Biomedical Sciences/Neuroscience uvádzajú celkovo 31 so 6,6,5 na HL vrátane Biology a ďalšieho prírodovedného predmetu. Psychology BSc uvádza celkovo 35 s prírodovedným predmetom na HL so známkou 6 plus GCSE Maths so známkou 5 (B) alebo ekvivalent na IB SL. Leeds University Business School - Economics BSc, Economics and Finance BSc, Business Management BA, International Business BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc - všetky uvádzajú celkovo 35 a 17 bodov na HL plus matematiku cez SL 5 alebo HL 4 a angličtinu cez SL/HL alebo cez inú kvalifikáciu. Law LLB: celkovo 35 (6,6,5 na HL). Medicine and Surgery MBChB: celkovo 36 so 6 z každého z 3 HL predmetov vrátane Chemistry a Biology; SL 5 z angličtiny a matematiky, ak ich nemáš z GCSE. Geography BA má 18 na HL; Geography BSc má 6,6,5 na HL vrátane uznávaného predmetu. Politics BA, International Relations BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA a Communication and Media BA uvádzajú celkovo 35 / 16 na HL (English Literature, Philosophy, Media and Communication pridávajú podmienku známky z angličtiny). Global Development BA a Sociology BA uvádzajú celkovo 34 (6,5,5 na HL). Fine Art BA uvádza celkovo 34 so 16 na HL a 4 z angličtiny. Food Science BSc a Nutrition BSc uvádzajú 6,5,5 na HL vrátane dvoch prírodovedných predmetov. Na všetky programy treba GCSE English Language so známkou 4 (C) (GCSE Maths so známkou 4 pre Food Science, Nutrition a niektoré programy Business). Kontextové ponuky Access to Leeds sú zvyčajne o 1-2 známky nižšie na úrovni A-level.

translations.en: Birmingham publishes the IB offer per course as a three-subject Higher Level slip plus a minimum overall diploma score of 32 points (Birmingham Undergraduate entry requirements page: "Our policy on the IB qualification is focused on attainment in the Higher Level subjects. Therefore, offers are based on three Higher Level grades with a minimum overall mark of 32." - "Note that this excludes Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences"). Published mappings: A*AA = 7,6,6 at Higher Level (with required subjects) and a minimum of 32 points overall; AAA = 6,6,6 at HL with 32 overall; AAB = 6,6,5 at HL with 32 overall; ABB = 6,5,5 at HL with 32 overall. Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science BSc and Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Computer Science BSc IB 7,6,6 at HL to include 6 in Mathematics plus 5 in Standard Level English, min 32 overall; Mathematics BSc IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics; Physics BSc IB 7,6,6 at HL including Mathematics and Physics; Chemistry BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,6,5 at HL including Chemistry; Biological Sciences BSc IB 6,6,5 including Biology/Human Biology plus one from Chemistry, Physics, Maths AA, Maths AI, Statistics, Geology, Geography or Psychology; Human Neuroscience BSc IB 6,6,6 at HL (no subject-specific condition); Psychology BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 at HL; Economics BSc IB 6,6,6 including Mathematics; Money, Banking and Finance BSc IB 6,6,5 at HL including Mathematics; Business Management BSc and Marketing BSc IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Accounting and Finance BSc IB 6,6,6 with 32 overall plus GCSE Mathematics grade 6; Law LLB IB 6,6,6 including 32 points overall (LNAT is NOT required - course page explicitly states Birmingham does not require or consider the LNAT); Medicine and Surgery MBChB IB 6,6,6 at HL including Chemistry and a second science from Biology/Physics/Maths plus UCAT and interview; Dental Surgery BDS IB 6,6,6 at HL including Chemistry and Biology with 32 overall plus UCAT and interview; Pharmacy MPharm IB 6,6,5 at HL including Chemistry plus Biology, Physics or Maths; Nursing (Adult) BNurs IB 5,5,5 at HL with three subjects; Mechanical / Civil / Electronic and Electrical / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics with 32 overall (Chemical Engineering MEng IB 7,6,6 at HL including Mathematics plus Chemistry or Physics HL grade 6; Materials Science and Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 at HL including Mathematics plus one of Computer Science, Biology, Physics, Chemistry or Design Technology); Politics BA and International Relations BA IB 6,6,5 at HL with 32 overall; Sociology BA, Ancient History and Archaeology BA IB 6,5,5 at HL with 32 overall; English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Liberal Arts BA IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Theology and Religion BA IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall; Modern Languages BA IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall plus Higher Level grade 5 for any advanced language; Music BMus IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall including HL 5 in Music (audition/interview may be required for applicants without the A-level Music equivalent or ABRSM Grade 8 Performance/Grade 6 Theory); Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 at HL dependent on the number of preferred science subjects; Geography BSc IB 6,6,5 with 32 overall; Environmental Science BSc IB 6,5,5 with 32 overall including a Required Science. General literacy/numeracy rule: GCSE English and GCSE Mathematics both grade 4 or above (some courses require higher); applicants must be 17 by 1 October of the year of entry (18 for programmes with mandatory clinical placements). Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year ("If your offer is for 2027 year of entry, we expect that the tuition fee for your first year of study will be GBP 10,050"; Parliament approval caveat).
translations.sk: Birmingham zverejňuje ponuku pre IB pre každý program ako kombináciu troch predmetov na Higher Level plus minimálne celkové skóre diplomu 32 bodov (stránka Birmingham Undergraduate entry requirements: "Our policy on the IB qualification is focused on attainment in the Higher Level subjects. Therefore, offers are based on three Higher Level grades with a minimum overall mark of 32." - "Note that this excludes Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences"). Zverejnené prevody: A*AA = 7,6,6 na Higher Level (s povinnými predmetmi) a minimálne celkovo 32 bodov; AAA = 6,6,6 na HL a celkovo 32; AAB = 6,6,5 na HL a celkovo 32; ABB = 6,5,5 na HL a celkovo 32. Príklady (nástup 2027): Computer Science BSc a Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Computer Science BSc IB 7,6,6 na HL vrátane 6 z Mathematics plus 5 zo Standard Level English, celkovo min. 32; Mathematics BSc IB 6,6,6 na HL vrátane Mathematics; Physics BSc IB 7,6,6 na HL vrátane Mathematics a Physics; Chemistry BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,6,5 na HL vrátane Chemistry; Biological Sciences BSc IB 6,6,5 vrátane Biology/Human Biology plus jedného z predmetov Chemistry, Physics, Maths AA, Maths AI, Statistics, Geology, Geography alebo Psychology; Human Neuroscience BSc IB 6,6,6 na HL (bez podmienky na konkrétny predmet); Psychology BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 na HL; Economics BSc IB 6,6,6 vrátane Mathematics; Money, Banking and Finance BSc IB 6,6,5 na HL vrátane Mathematics; Business Management BSc a Marketing BSc IB 6,6,5 a celkovo 32; Accounting and Finance BSc IB 6,6,6 a celkovo 32 plus GCSE Mathematics so známkou 6; Law LLB IB 6,6,6 a celkovo 32 bodov (LNAT sa NEVYŽADUJE - stránka programu výslovne uvádza, že Birmingham LNAT nevyžaduje ani nezohľadňuje); Medicine and Surgery MBChB IB 6,6,6 na HL vrátane Chemistry a druhého prírodovedného predmetu z Biology/Physics/Maths plus UCAT a pohovor; Dental Surgery BDS IB 6,6,6 na HL vrátane Chemistry a Biology a celkovo 32 plus UCAT a pohovor; Pharmacy MPharm IB 6,6,5 na HL vrátane Chemistry plus Biology, Physics alebo Maths; Nursing (Adult) BNurs IB 5,5,5 na HL z troch predmetov; Mechanical / Civil / Electronic and Electrical / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 na HL vrátane Mathematics a celkovo 32 (Chemical Engineering MEng IB 7,6,6 na HL vrátane Mathematics plus Chemistry alebo Physics na HL so známkou 6; Materials Science and Engineering MEng IB 6,6,6 na HL vrátane Mathematics plus jedného z predmetov Computer Science, Biology, Physics, Chemistry alebo Design Technology); Politics BA a International Relations BA IB 6,6,5 na HL a celkovo 32; Sociology BA, Ancient History and Archaeology BA IB 6,5,5 na HL a celkovo 32; English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Liberal Arts BA IB 6,6,5 a celkovo 32; Theology and Religion BA IB 6,5,5 a celkovo 32; Modern Languages BA IB 6,5,5 a celkovo 32 plus známka 5 na Higher Level pre každý pokročilý jazyk; Music BMus IB 6,6,5 a celkovo 32 vrátane HL 5 z Music (od uchádzačov bez ekvivalentu A-level Music alebo ABRSM Grade 8 Performance/Grade 6 Theory môžu vyžadovať konkurz/pohovor); Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences BSc IB 6,6,6 - 6,5,5 na HL v závislosti od počtu preferovaných prírodovedných predmetov; Geography BSc IB 6,6,5 a celkovo 32; Environmental Science BSc IB 6,5,5 a celkovo 32 vrátane povinného prírodovedného predmetu (Required Science). Všeobecné pravidlo pre gramotnosť a počtárstvo: GCSE English aj GCSE Mathematics so známkou 4 alebo vyššou (niektoré programy vyžadujú vyššiu); uchádzači musia mať 17 rokov do 1. októbra roku nástupu (18 pri programoch s povinnou klinickou praxou). Školné Home je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 ročne ("If your offer is for 2027 year of entry, we expect that the tuition fee for your first year of study will be GBP 10,050"; s výhradou schválenia parlamentom).

translations.en: Southampton does not publish a single blanket IB Diploma minimum; entry requirements are stated per course page as a total Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Archaeology BA 'Pass, with overall score of 30 points with 15 points at Higher Level'; Computer Science BSc 'Pass, with 34 points overall, with 17 points required at Higher Level including 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Biomedical Engineering MEng 'Pass, with 38 points overall with 19 points required at Higher Level, including 6 at Higher Level in Physics (or Biology/Chemistry/Computer Science) and 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Medicine BM5 BMBS 'Overall score of 36 points with 18 at Higher Level, with 6 in Biology and one additional Science'). Southampton accepts both Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL) for all IB-relevant undergraduate courses (per course page IB Diploma entries); Analysis and Approaches is preferred for many Engineering/CS/Maths/Physics courses; Acoustical Engineering MEng explicitly asks either 6 at HL in AA or 7 at HL in AI. Applicants without the required HL subjects can apply for the Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year. GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above is typically required, or an equivalent (course page 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University'). IB Career-Related Programme (IBCP) accepted — 'Offers will be made on the individual Diploma Course subject(s) and the career-related study qualification. The CP core will not form part of the offer.' Contextual offers available for eligible Home applicants ('Applicants who are highlighted in this way will be made an offer which is lower than the typical offer for that programme'). Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (course pages 'UK students pay GBP 10,050'; Southampton Tuition fees, funding and scholarships undergraduate page).
translations.sk: Southampton nezverejňuje jedno spoločné minimum pre IB diplom; vstupné požiadavky sú uvedené na stránke každého programu ako celkový počet bodov z diplomu plus kombinácia na Higher Level (napr. Archaeology BA 'Pass, with overall score of 30 points with 15 points at Higher Level'; Computer Science BSc 'Pass, with 34 points overall, with 17 points required at Higher Level including 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Biomedical Engineering MEng 'Pass, with 38 points overall with 19 points required at Higher Level, including 6 at Higher Level in Physics (or Biology/Chemistry/Computer Science) and 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Medicine BM5 BMBS 'Overall score of 36 points with 18 at Higher Level, with 6 in Biology and one additional Science'). Southampton uznáva Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) aj Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL) pri všetkých bakalárskych programoch, ktorých sa IB týka (podľa údajov o IB diplome na stránkach programov); pri mnohých programoch Engineering/CS/Maths/Physics má prednosť Analysis and Approaches; Acoustical Engineering MEng výslovne žiada buď 6 na HL z AA, alebo 7 na HL z AI. Uchádzači bez požadovaných HL predmetov sa môžu prihlásiť na Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year. Zvyčajne sa vyžaduje GCSE English Language (alebo GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics so známkou 4/C alebo vyššou, alebo ekvivalent (stránka programu: 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University'). IB Career-Related Programme (IBCP) sa uznáva — 'Offers will be made on the individual Diploma Course subject(s) and the career-related study qualification. The CP core will not form part of the offer.' Kontextové ponuky sú dostupné pre oprávnených uchádzačov Home ('Applicants who are highlighted in this way will be made an offer which is lower than the typical offer for that programme'). Školné Home je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 ročne (stránky programov 'UK students pay GBP 10,050'; stránka Southampton Tuition fees, funding and scholarships pre bakalárske štúdium).

translations.en: Sheffield publishes an IB Diploma offer per course, stated as an overall Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Computer Science BSc IB Diploma: '36, with 6 in HL Maths; 34, with 6 in HL Maths, and A in the Extended Essay; 34, with 6 in HL Maths and 5 in HL Computer Science'; A Level AAA including Maths / AAB including A in Maths and B in Computer Science). The standard typical-offer headline is usually one or two points above the alternative one which is conditional on grade A in the Extended Essay (or equivalent). Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science / Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths + A in EE, or + 5 in HL CS); Mathematics BSc and Financial Mathematics BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches) (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths AA + A in EE); Physics BSc IB 34 with 6,5 (in any order) in HL Maths and Physics (or 33 with 5 in HL Maths and Physics + B in EE); Physics MPhys IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths and Physics (or 34 with 6,5 + A in EE); Chemistry BSc / Chemistry MChem IB 34 with 5 in HL Chemistry (or 33 + B in EE); Biological Sciences BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in HL Biology and a second science (or 33 + A in a science-based EE); Biomedical Science BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in two HL science subjects; Psychology BSc IB 34 with 5 in a HL science subject; Data Science BSc IB 34 (or 33 with A in a science-based EE); Economics BSc IB 34 with 5 in HL Maths (or 33 + B in EE); Business Management BA / Accounting and Financial Management BA IB 34 (or 33 with A in the EE); Law LLB IB 36 (or 34 with A in the EE); Medicine MBChB IB 36 with 6 in three HL subjects including Chemistry or Biology and a second science, and no less than 4 in all SL subjects; Dental Surgery BDS IB 36 with 6 in HL Chemistry and Biology; Nursing (Adult) BMedSci IB 32; Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering MEng IB 38 with 6 in HL Maths and at least one of Physics/Chemistry/Biology (or 36 with + A in a science-based EE for Mechanical); Civil and Structural / Electrical and Electronic / Chemical / Materials Science and Engineering / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6,5 in HL Maths and a science + A/B in the EE); Architecture BA IB 36 (or 34 + A in the EE) plus portfolio and GCSE Maths grade 4/C; Landscape Architecture BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE) plus portfolio; Journalism Studies BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Digital Media and Society / Sociology BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Politics and International Relations / Criminology BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Geography BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Urban Studies and Planning MPlan(UG) IB 33 (or 32 with B in a social-science based EE) plus GCSE Maths grade 4/C; English Literature BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); History BA and Philosophy BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Modern Languages and Cultures BA IB 33 typically with 5 in a HL modern foreign language (or 32 with B in the EE). Where IB offers are a range, the lower bound is conditional on the Extended Essay / additional HL grade as stated on the course page. GCSE English Language and GCSE Maths grade 4/C or above (some courses higher) are typically required; many Engineering and Psychology courses require GCSE Maths grade 6/B or 5/B. Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (Sheffield Undergraduate tuition fees 2027 page: 'The standard annual undergraduate tuition fee for home fee-paying students starting their course in 2027 is GBP 10,050').
translations.sk: Sheffield zverejňuje ponuku pre IB diplom pre každý program ako celkový počet bodov z diplomu plus kombináciu na Higher Level (napr. Computer Science BSc IB Diploma: '36, with 6 in HL Maths; 34, with 6 in HL Maths, and A in the Extended Essay; 34, with 6 in HL Maths and 5 in HL Computer Science'; A Level AAA vrátane Maths / AAB vrátane A z Maths a B z Computer Science). Hlavná typická ponuka je zvyčajne o jeden či dva body vyššia ako alternatívna, ktorá je podmienená známkou A z Extended Essay (alebo ekvivalentom). Príklady (nástup 2027): Computer Science / Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) BSc IB 36 so 6 z HL Maths (alebo 34 so 6 z HL Maths + A z EE, alebo + 5 z HL CS); Mathematics BSc a Financial Mathematics BSc IB 36 so 6 z HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches) (alebo 34 so 6 z HL Maths AA + A z EE); Physics BSc IB 34 so 6,5 (v ľubovoľnom poradí) z HL Maths a Physics (alebo 33 s 5 z HL Maths a Physics + B z EE); Physics MPhys IB 36 so 6 z HL Maths a Physics (alebo 34 so 6,5 + A z EE); Chemistry BSc / Chemistry MChem IB 34 s 5 z HL Chemistry (alebo 33 + B z EE); Biological Sciences BSc IB 34 so 6,5 z HL Biology a druhého prírodovedného predmetu (alebo 33 + A z EE z prírodných vied); Biomedical Science BSc IB 34 so 6,5 z dvoch prírodovedných predmetov na HL; Psychology BSc IB 34 s 5 z prírodovedného predmetu na HL; Data Science BSc IB 34 (alebo 33 s A z EE z prírodných vied); Economics BSc IB 34 s 5 z HL Maths (alebo 33 + B z EE); Business Management BA / Accounting and Financial Management BA IB 34 (alebo 33 s A z EE); Law LLB IB 36 (alebo 34 s A z EE); Medicine MBChB IB 36 so 6 z troch HL predmetov vrátane Chemistry alebo Biology a druhého prírodovedného predmetu a aspoň 4 zo všetkých SL predmetov; Dental Surgery BDS IB 36 so 6 z HL Chemistry a Biology; Nursing (Adult) BMedSci IB 32; Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering MEng IB 38 so 6 z HL Maths a aspoň jedného z predmetov Physics/Chemistry/Biology (alebo pri Mechanical 36 + A z EE z prírodných vied); Civil and Structural / Electrical and Electronic / Chemical / Materials Science and Engineering / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 36 so 6 z HL Maths (alebo 34 so 6,5 z HL Maths a prírodovedného predmetu + A/B z EE); Architecture BA IB 36 (alebo 34 + A z EE) plus portfólio a GCSE Maths so známkou 4/C; Landscape Architecture BA IB 33 (alebo 32 s B z EE) plus portfólio; Journalism Studies BA IB 33 (alebo 32 s B z EE); Digital Media and Society / Sociology BA IB 33 (alebo 32 s B z EE); Politics and International Relations / Criminology BA IB 34 (alebo 33 s B z EE); Geography BA IB 34 (alebo 33 s B z EE); Urban Studies and Planning MPlan(UG) IB 33 (alebo 32 s B z EE zo spoločenských vied) plus GCSE Maths so známkou 4/C; English Literature BA IB 34 (alebo 33 s B z EE); History BA a Philosophy BA IB 34 (alebo 33 s B z EE); Modern Languages and Cultures BA IB 33 zvyčajne s 5 z moderného cudzieho jazyka na HL (alebo 32 s B z EE). Ak je ponuka pre IB rozpätie, dolná hranica je podmienená Extended Essay / ďalšou HL známkou, ako uvádza stránka programu. Zvyčajne sa vyžaduje GCSE English Language a GCSE Maths so známkou 4/C alebo vyššou (niektoré programy vyššie); mnohé programy Engineering a Psychology vyžadujú GCSE Maths so známkou 6/B alebo 5/B. Školné Home je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 ročne (stránka Sheffield Undergraduate tuition fees 2027: 'The standard annual undergraduate tuition fee for home fee-paying students starting their course in 2027 is GBP 10,050').

translations.sk: Angličtina na úrovni známky 4 z nórskeho základného kurzu · väčšina zahraničných uchádzačov potrebuje schválený test

translations.en: Standard level: IELTS 7.5 (min 7.0 per component). IB route: English B HL 7 (or exemption if IB taught in English).
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň: IELTS 7.5 (min. 7.0 z každej časti). Cez IB: English B HL 7 (alebo výnimka, ak máš IB v angličtine).

translations.en: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall (usually min 7.0 each element). C1-level English via school-leaving qual (e.g. IB English A HL) also accepted.
translations.sk: IELTS Academic celkovo 7.5 (zvyčajne min. 7.0 z každej časti). Uznáva sa aj angličtina na úrovni C1 doložená dokladom o ukončení strednej školy (napr. IB English A HL).

translations.en: Standard level: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 each); Higher level: IELTS 7.0 (min 6.5 each). IB route: English A (Lit or Lang&Lit) grade 4 SL/HL, or English B grade 6 SL / 5 HL.
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 z každej časti); vyššia úroveň: IELTS 7.0 (min. 6.5 z každej časti). Cez IB: English A (Lit alebo Lang&Lit) so známkou 4 na SL/HL, alebo English B so známkou 6 na SL / 5 na HL.

translations.en: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 7.0 in each component (one sitting). IB route: English A (Literature, Language & Literature, or Literature & Performance) any grade HL / at least 6 SL, or English B 7 HL.
translations.sk: IELTS Academic celkovo 7.0 a 7.0 z každej časti (v jednom termíne). Cez IB: English A (Literature, Language & Literature alebo Literature & Performance) s akoukoľvek známkou na HL / aspoň 6 na SL, alebo English B 7 na HL.

translations.en: UCL English levels 1-5; most UG programmes require Level 2: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, min 6.5 each component. IB route: English A (Literature or Language & Literature) grade 5 at HL/SL for Levels 1-2 (grade 6 for Level 3); English B accepted only for Level 1.
translations.sk: Jazykové úrovne angličtiny UCL 1-5; väčšina bakalárskych programov vyžaduje Level 2: IELTS Academic celkovo 7.0, min. 6.5 z každej časti. Cez IB: English A (Literature alebo Language & Literature) so známkou 5 na HL/SL pre Levels 1-2 (známka 6 pre Level 3); English B sa uznáva len pre Level 1.

translations.en: IB SL English at 5 (English ab initio not accepted); IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each component typical (some programmes 7.0 with 6.0; Medicine 7.5 with 7.5).
translations.sk: IB English SL so známkou 5 (English ab initio sa neuznáva); zvyčajne IELTS Academic 6.5 a aspoň 5.5 z každej časti (niektoré programy 7.0 a 6.0; medicína 7.5 a 7.5).

translations.en: English bands A-E. IB route (all bands): English A (Language/Literature/Language & Literature) HL 4 or SL 5, or English B HL 5 or SL 7. IELTS Academic: Band B 7.0 overall min 6.5 each skill (most courses incl. Law, Medicine, Business, SSPP, Nursing, IoPPN); Band D 6.5 overall min 6.0 each skill (Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences except General/Electronic Engineering and Quantitative Mathematics which are Band B).
translations.sk: Jazykové pásma angličtiny A-E. Cez IB (všetky pásma): English A (Language/Literature/Language & Literature) HL 4 alebo SL 5, alebo English B HL 5 alebo SL 7. IELTS Academic: Band B celkovo 7.0, min. 6.5 z každej zručnosti (väčšina programov vrátane Law, Medicine, Business, SSPP, Nursing, IoPPN); Band D celkovo 6.5, min. 6.0 z každej zručnosti (Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences okrem General/Electronic Engineering a Quantitative Mathematics, ktoré patria do Band B).

translations.en: Course-specific minimums: most courses require GCSE/IGCSE English Language C/4-B/6 or IELTS 6.5 (no sub-skill below 6.0-6.5); Psychology, Law, Nursing, EEE, English Literature, History, Medicine and Dentistry require IELTS 7.0 variants. IB English route (UoM equivalence table, at GCSE C/4-B/6 level): English A: Literature or English A: Language & Literature HL 4 or SL 4, or English B HL 5 or SL 6.
translations.sk: Minimá podľa programu: väčšina programov vyžaduje GCSE/IGCSE English Language C/4-B/6 alebo IELTS 6.5 (žiadna časť pod 6.0-6.5); Psychology, Law, Nursing, EEE, English Literature, History, Medicine a Dentistry vyžadujú varianty IELTS 7.0. Cesta cez IB English (tabuľka rovnocenných kvalifikácií UoM, na úrovni GCSE C/4-B/6): English A: Literature alebo English A: Language & Literature HL 4 alebo SL 4, alebo English B HL 5 alebo SL 6.

translations.en: Course-assigned Bristol English profiles A-G with IB routes on each profile page. Profile E (most sciences, engineering, geography): IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills; IB English A: Literature 5 at SL or 4 at HL / A: Literature and Language 5 at SL or HL / B: English 6 at SL or 5 at HL. Profile B (Law, Psychology, History, Philosophy, Veterinary Science): IELTS 7.0 with 7.0 in writing and 6.5 in all other skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or 5 HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. Profile A (Medicine, Dentistry, English BA): IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in all skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 7 SL or 6 HL / B 7 at HL. Profile G (Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Mathematics, Accounting and Finance, International Business Management): IELTS 6.5 with 7.0 in reading and listening, no score below 6.0; IB A: Literature 5 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. Profile C (Politics and International Relations): IELTS 6.5 with 6.5 in all skills; IB A: Literature and A: Literature and Language 5 at SL or HL / B 6 at SL or HL.
translations.sk: Bristol priraďuje programom jazykové profily angličtiny A-G, cesty cez IB sú na stránke každého profilu. Profile E (väčšina prírodných vied, inžinierstvo, geografia): IELTS celkovo 6.5, zo všetkých zručností 6.0; IB English A: Literature 5 na SL alebo 4 na HL / A: Literature and Language 5 na SL alebo HL / B: English 6 na SL alebo 5 na HL. Profile B (Law, Psychology, History, Philosophy, Veterinary Science): IELTS 7.0, z písania 7.0 a zo všetkých ostatných zručností 6.5; IB A: Literature 6 SL alebo 5 HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL alebo 5 HL / B 7 SL alebo 6 HL. Profile A (Medicine, Dentistry, English BA): IELTS 7.5, zo všetkých zručností 7.0; IB A: Literature 6 SL alebo HL / A: Literature and Language 7 SL alebo 6 HL / B 7 na HL. Profile G (Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Mathematics, Accounting and Finance, International Business Management): IELTS 6.5, z čítania a počúvania 7.0, žiadne skóre pod 6.0; IB A: Literature 5 SL alebo HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL alebo 5 HL / B 7 SL alebo 6 HL. Profile C (Politics and International Relations): IELTS 6.5, zo všetkých zručností 6.5; IB A: Literature a A: Literature and Language 5 na SL alebo HL / B 6 na SL alebo HL.

translations.en: Three-band English system (Warwick English Language Requirements, page updated 28 October 2026). Band A (most STEM: Computer Science, Discrete Mathematics, Data Science, Mathematics, MMath, Mathematics and Physics, Mathematics and Statistics, Engineering, Biomedical Science, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, Biological Sciences): IELTS 6.0 min 5.5 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 4 or SL 4; IB English B HL 4 or SL 5. Band B (Psychology, Cyber Security, MORSE, English Literature, History, Philosophy, Film and Television Studies, Modern Languages): IELTS 6.5 min 6.0 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 4 or SL 4; IB English B HL 4 or SL 5. Band C (Economics, Economics and Management, EPAIS, PPE, Law LLB, Accounting and Finance, Management, International Management): IELTS 7.0 min 6.5 in each component; IB English A (any) HL 5 or SL 5; IB English B HL 5 or SL 6. Economics-family course pages add explicit GCSE/IB English caveat: "You will also need grade 6/B in GCSE English Language or International Baccalaureate grade 5 in English A (Higher or Standard Level), grade 5 in Higher Level English B or grade 6 in Standard Level English B."
translations.sk: Systém troch pásiem pre angličtinu (Warwick English Language Requirements, stránka aktualizovaná 28. októbra 2026). Band A (väčšina STEM: Computer Science, Discrete Mathematics, Data Science, Mathematics, MMath, Mathematics and Physics, Mathematics and Statistics, Engineering, Biomedical Science, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, Biological Sciences): IELTS 6.0, min. 5.5 z každej časti; IB English A (akákoľvek) HL 4 alebo SL 4; IB English B HL 4 alebo SL 5. Band B (Psychology, Cyber Security, MORSE, English Literature, History, Philosophy, Film and Television Studies, Modern Languages): IELTS 6.5, min. 6.0 z každej časti; IB English A (akákoľvek) HL 4 alebo SL 4; IB English B HL 4 alebo SL 5. Band C (Economics, Economics and Management, EPAIS, PPE, Law LLB, Accounting and Finance, Management, International Management): IELTS 7.0, min. 6.5 z každej časti; IB English A (akákoľvek) HL 5 alebo SL 5; IB English B HL 5 alebo SL 6. Stránky programov typu Economics pridávajú výslovnú výhradu ku GCSE/IB English: "You will also need grade 6/B in GCSE English Language or International Baccalaureate grade 5 in English A (Higher or Standard Level), grade 5 in Higher Level English B or grade 6 in Standard Level English B."

translations.en: IB route (Durham Other English Language Qualifications page): 'International Baccalaureate Standard or Higher level English 5 or better'. Otherwise IELTS Academic band 6.5-7.0 overall (no element below band 6.0), as stated on Durham course pages.
translations.sk: Cez IB (stránka Durham Other English Language Qualifications): 'International Baccalaureate Standard or Higher level English 5 or better'. Inak IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5-7.0 (žiadna časť pod 6.0), ako uvádzajú stránky programov v Durhame.

translations.en: Three-category system (Bath English language requirements for qualifications pages). All three categories accept the IB route: 'International Baccalaureate - Standard or Higher Level in English (any) Grade 3'. Otherwise IELTS Academic: Category C (Computer Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Sport and Exercise Science, Sport Management and Coaching, Modern Languages, Economics and Mathematics): IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in all components. Category A (Management, Management with Marketing, Business, Accounting and Finance, International Management and Modern Languages, Psychology, Architecture) and Category B (Economics, Pharmacy MPharm, Criminology, Sociology and Social Policy, International Development with Economics): IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in all components. Bath's published Category A and Category B pages currently print identical IELTS/IB requirements.
translations.sk: Systém troch kategórií (stránky Bath o jazykových požiadavkách pre jednotlivé kvalifikácie). Všetky tri kategórie uznávajú cestu cez IB: 'International Baccalaureate - Standard or Higher Level in English (any) Grade 3'. Inak IELTS Academic: Category C (Computer Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Sport and Exercise Science, Sport Management and Coaching, Modern Languages, Economics and Mathematics): IELTS celkovo 6.5 a vo všetkých častiach aspoň 6.0. Category A (Management, Management with Marketing, Business, Accounting and Finance, International Management and Modern Languages, Psychology, Architecture) a Category B (Economics, Pharmacy MPharm, Criminology, Sociology and Social Policy, International Development with Economics): IELTS celkovo 7.0 a vo všetkých častiach aspoň 6.5. Zverejnené stránky Bath pre Category A a Category B momentálne uvádzajú rovnaké požiadavky IELTS/IB.

translations.en: Faculty English-language profiles (test-taker route): Faculty of Science Profile 7-D IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component; Faculty of Arts and Divinity (all Schools except the School of English) Profile 3-D IELTS 7.0 with 6.5 in each; School of English Profile 1-D IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in each; Medicine Profile 2-M. No test score needed if the applicant holds an English-medium secondary/high-school leaving qualification taken at a school with a substantial English-language educational environment (registered for at least the final two years; schools in UKVI majority English-speaking countries, Singapore and IB English-medium schools meet this), including at least one subject with a substantial component of writing in English. Test scores accepted only within two years of the programme start date.
translations.sk: Jazykové profily angličtiny podľa fakulty (cesta cez test): Faculty of Science Profile 7-D IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5 a 6.0 z každej časti; Faculty of Arts and Divinity (všetky Schools okrem School of English) Profile 3-D IELTS 7.0 a 6.5 z každej časti; School of English Profile 1-D IELTS 7.5 a 7.0 z každej časti; Medicine Profile 2-M. Výsledok testu netreba, ak máš doklad o ukončení strednej školy s výučbou v angličtine zo školy s výrazne anglickým vzdelávacím prostredím (štúdium na nej aspoň posledné dva roky; túto podmienku spĺňajú školy v krajinách, ktoré UKVI vedie ako prevažne anglicky hovoriace, v Singapure a IB školy s výučbou v angličtine), vrátane aspoň jedného predmetu s podstatnou časťou písania v angličtine. Výsledky testov sa uznávajú len vtedy, ak nie sú staršie ako dva roky k dátumu začiatku programu.

translations.en: Glasgow standard English route: International Baccalaureate English A SL5 or HL5, or English B SL6 or HL5. IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no subtests below 6.0 is the standard for non-English-speaking applicants; some programmes (Medicine, Dentistry, Law) require IELTS 7.0 with 7.0 in each component - see course page for current exact requirement.
translations.sk: Štandardná cesta Glasgow pre angličtinu: International Baccalaureate English A SL5 alebo HL5, alebo English B SL6 alebo HL5. Štandard pre uchádzačov, ktorých materinský jazyk nie je angličtina, je IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5, žiadna časť pod 6.0; niektoré programy (medicína, zubné lekárstvo, právo) vyžadujú IELTS 7.0 a 7.0 z každej časti - presnú aktuálnu požiadavku nájdeš na stránke programu.

translations.en: Exeter English language Profiles A-G vary by course (named on each course page). Profiles B1 and B2 cover most undergraduate courses: B1 = IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in any section; B2 = IELTS 6.5 overall and no less than 6.0 in any section (e.g. Biosciences, Psychology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Exercise and Sport Sciences). IB route for Profiles A, B1 and B2: International Baccalaureate English as a First Language Language A: Literature or Language A: Language and Literature Grade 4 at SL or HL; Language B: English Grade 6 at SL or Grade 5 at HL. BMBS Medicine requires Profile G: IELTS 7.5 with no less than 7.0 in any section; IB English A SL5 or HL4, English B SL7 or HL6. Alternatives include TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, pre-sessional English at the University of Exeter International Study Centre; tests valid 2 years before programme start (school qualifications such as IB accepted for 7 years).
translations.sk: Jazykové profily angličtiny Exeter A-G sa líšia podľa programu (uvedené na stránke každého programu). Profiles B1 a B2 pokrývajú väčšinu bakalárskych programov: B1 = IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5 a v žiadnej časti menej ako 5.5; B2 = IELTS celkovo 6.5 a v žiadnej časti menej ako 6.0 (napr. Biosciences, Psychology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Exercise and Sport Sciences). Cez IB pre Profiles A, B1 a B2: International Baccalaureate English ako prvý jazyk, Language A: Literature alebo Language A: Language and Literature so známkou 4 na SL alebo HL; Language B: English so známkou 6 na SL alebo 5 na HL. BMBS Medicine vyžaduje Profile G: IELTS 7.5 a v žiadnej časti menej ako 7.0; IB English A SL5 alebo HL4, English B SL7 alebo HL6. Alternatívy zahŕňajú TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, prípravnú angličtinu (pre-sessional) v University of Exeter International Study Centre; testy platia 2 roky pred začiatkom programu (stredoškolské kvalifikácie ako IB sa uznávajú 7 rokov).

translations.en: Standard undergraduate band is IELTS 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each section (Leeds English language requirements page). IB route: English A (first language) Literature or Language and Literature grade 4 at HL or SL; English B (second language) grade 5 at HL or 6 at SL; English Literature and Performance and English Ab Initio not accepted; English B SL not accepted for courses with IELTS 7.0+ requirement. Medicine MBChB requires IELTS 7.5 overall with no less than 7.5 in Spoken English.
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň pre bakalárske štúdium je IELTS celkovo 6.0, z každej časti aspoň 5.5 (stránka Leeds o jazykových požiadavkách). Cez IB: English A (prvý jazyk) Literature alebo Language and Literature so známkou 4 na HL alebo SL; English B (druhý jazyk) so známkou 5 na HL alebo 6 na SL; English Literature and Performance a English Ab Initio sa neuznávajú; English B SL sa neuznáva pre programy s požiadavkou IELTS 7.0+. Medicine MBChB vyžaduje IELTS celkovo 7.5, z hovorenia (Spoken English) aspoň 7.5.

translations.en: Standard undergraduate band is IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any band (engineering, sciences, geography, environmental science). Birmingham Business School and Law programmes (Economics BSc, Money Banking and Finance BSc, Business Management BSc, Marketing BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc) require IELTS 6.5 overall with minimum of 6.5 in Writing and Speaking and 6.0 in Listening and Reading. Law LLB, Politics BA, International Relations BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Modern Languages BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Human Neuroscience BSc and Psychology BSc require IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any band. Medicine MBChB, Dentistry BDS and Nursing (Adult) BNurs require IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 7.0 in any band; Pharmacy MPharm requires IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in any band. IB English route is built into the IB offer per course (e.g. Computer Science course page: "We also require 5 in Standard Level English"). Alternatives: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, Cambridge English C1 Advanced, LanguageCert ESOL SELT, Trinity ISE II/III; Presessional English course offered for applicants with a conditional offer.
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň pre bakalárske štúdium je IELTS Academic celkovo 6.0, v žiadnej časti menej ako 5.5 (inžinierstvo, prírodné vedy, geografia, environmentálna veda). Programy Birmingham Business School a Law (Economics BSc, Money Banking and Finance BSc, Business Management BSc, Marketing BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc) vyžadujú IELTS celkovo 6.5, minimálne 6.5 z písania a hovorenia a 6.0 z počúvania a čítania. Law LLB, Politics BA, International Relations BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Modern Languages BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Human Neuroscience BSc a Psychology BSc vyžadujú IELTS celkovo 6.5, v žiadnej časti menej ako 6.0. Medicine MBChB, Dentistry BDS a Nursing (Adult) BNurs vyžadujú IELTS celkovo 7.0, v žiadnej časti menej ako 7.0; Pharmacy MPharm vyžaduje IELTS celkovo 7.0, v žiadnej časti menej ako 6.5. Cesta cez IB English je súčasťou ponuky pre IB pri každom programe (napr. stránka Computer Science: "We also require 5 in Standard Level English"). Alternatívy: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, Cambridge English C1 Advanced, LanguageCert ESOL SELT, Trinity ISE II/III; uchádzačom s podmienenou ponukou ponúkajú prípravný kurz angličtiny (Presessional English).

translations.en: Standard Southampton undergraduate band is IELTS Academic overall score 6.5 with minimum 6.0 in reading, 6.0 in writing, 6.0 in speaking and 6.0 in listening (course pages 'IELTS score requirements': overall 6.5 / reading 6.0 / writing 6.0 / speaking 6.0 / listening 6.0). Law LLB requires IELTS overall 6.5 with minimum 6.5 in each component (Law LLB course page IELTS score requirements). Medicine BM5 BMBS requires IELTS overall 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in each component (Medicine BM5 course page IELTS score requirements). Pre-sessional English programmes offered where the IELTS requirement is not met (course pages: 'If you do not meet the English language requirements through a test or qualification, you may be able to meet them by completing one of our pre-sessional English programmes before your course starts'). English language equivalency routes (TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge English, etc.) and IB-based English equivalencies live on Southampton's English language requirements pages (https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements).
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň Southamptonu pre bakalárske štúdium je IELTS Academic celkovo 6.5, minimálne 6.0 z čítania, 6.0 z písania, 6.0 z hovorenia a 6.0 z počúvania (stránky programov 'IELTS score requirements': celkovo 6.5 / čítanie 6.0 / písanie 6.0 / hovorenie 6.0 / počúvanie 6.0). Law LLB vyžaduje IELTS celkovo 6.5, minimálne 6.5 z každej časti (stránka Law LLB, požiadavky na skóre IELTS). Medicine BM5 BMBS vyžaduje IELTS celkovo 7.0, minimálne 7.0 z každej časti (stránka Medicine BM5, požiadavky na skóre IELTS). Ak požiadavku IELTS nesplníš, ponúkajú prípravné kurzy angličtiny (pre-sessional) (stránky programov: 'If you do not meet the English language requirements through a test or qualification, you may be able to meet them by completing one of our pre-sessional English programmes before your course starts'). Iné spôsoby preukázania angličtiny (TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge English atď.) a ekvivalenty angličtiny cez IB sú na stránkach Southamptonu o jazykových požiadavkách (https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements).

translations.en: Standard Sheffield undergraduate band is IELTS Academic grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 4/C (most course pages 'For this course we require: GCSE English Language at grade 4/C; IELTS grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component'). Law LLB, English Literature BA and Modern Languages and Cultures BA require IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component. Journalism Studies BA and Medicine MBChB require IELTS 7.5 with minimum 7.0 in each component; Medicine also requires GCSE English Language at grade 6/B. Dental Surgery BDS requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 7/A. Nursing (Adult) BMedSci requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in Speaking, Reading and Listening, and 6.5 in Writing, plus GCSE English Language grade 4/C. IB English equivalencies on Sheffield English language requirements for undergraduates page: 'International Baccalaureate (IB) Standard or Higher Level English A: Language and Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard Level English B Grade 6 or above; IB Higher Level English B Grade 5 or above.' Alternatives: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert Academic SELT, Trinity ISE III/IV; pre-sessional English at the University ELTC and International Foundation Year / International Year One at the University of Sheffield International College meet the requirement.
translations.sk: Štandardná úroveň Sheffieldu pre bakalárske štúdium je IELTS Academic 6.5, minimálne 6.0 z každej časti, plus GCSE English Language so známkou 4/C (väčšina stránok programov: 'For this course we require: GCSE English Language at grade 4/C; IELTS grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component'). Law LLB, English Literature BA a Modern Languages and Cultures BA vyžadujú IELTS 7.0, minimálne 6.5 z každej časti. Journalism Studies BA a Medicine MBChB vyžadujú IELTS 7.5, minimálne 7.0 z každej časti; Medicine vyžaduje aj GCSE English Language so známkou 6/B. Dental Surgery BDS vyžaduje IELTS 7.0, minimálne 6.5 z každej časti, plus GCSE English Language so známkou 7/A. Nursing (Adult) BMedSci vyžaduje IELTS 7.0, minimálne 7.0 z hovorenia, čítania a počúvania a 6.5 z písania, plus GCSE English Language so známkou 4/C. Ekvivalenty IB English na stránke Sheffieldu o jazykových požiadavkách pre bakalárske štúdium: 'International Baccalaureate (IB) Standard or Higher Level English A: Language and Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard Level English B Grade 6 or above; IB Higher Level English B Grade 5 or above.' Alternatívy: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert Academic SELT, Trinity ISE III/IV; požiadavku splní aj prípravná angličtina (pre-sessional) na univerzitnom ELTC a International Foundation Year / International Year One na University of Sheffield International College.

translations.en: German C1 before admission (the IB German subject counts only as A2)
translations.sk: Nemčina C1 pred prijatím (predmet IB German sa počíta len ako A2)

translations.sk: Nemčina C1 pred prijatím

translations.sk: IB English 5+, alebo uznávaný test z angličtiny

translations.en: Dual Degree application (Columbia GS) · EU applicants must also apply to Trinity through CAO and get an offer
translations.sk: Prihláška na Dual Degree (Columbia GS) · uchádzači z EÚ sa musia prihlásiť aj na Trinity cez CAO a dostať ponuku

translations.en: Common App: choose USC, then WBB (code 1485) as first-choice programme
translations.sk: Common App: vyber USC, potom WBB (kód 1485) ako program prvej voľby
